name: Resistance Band Ankle Dorsiflexion
pose_description: Sit in a chair with one leg extended or knee bent at 90 degrees. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot and hold the ends of the band in both hands.
end_pose_description: Pull your toes upward toward your shin against the band resistance, creating tension along the front of your lower leg and the top of your foot. Slowly return to the starting position.

name: Band-Assisted Hip Flexor Stretch
pose_description: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended forward, and loop a resistance band around the extended leg's foot. Maintain an upright torso with core engaged.
end_pose_description: Gently press your hips forward while using the band to assist the stretch on the hip flexor of the kneeling leg. Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning backward to maintain proper spinal alignment.

name: Band External Rotation
pose_description: Sit upright with your right elbow bent at 90 degrees, tucked against your side with your forearm pointing forward. Hold the resistance band in your right hand while anchoring the other end with your left hand or foot.
end_pose_description: Rotate your right forearm outward against the band resistance, moving your hand away from your body in an arc. Keep your elbow firmly against your ribs throughout the movement.

name: Band Shoulder Internal Rotation
pose_description: Sit upright with your left elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your side, forearm pointing outward. Hold the resistance band in your left hand while anchoring the opposite end with your right hand or by stepping on it.
end_pose_description: Rotate your left forearm inward across your body against the band resistance, keeping your elbow stationary at your ribs. Complete all repetitions on one side before switching to the opposite shoulder.

name: Band Lat Pulldown
pose_description: Sit upright with your core engaged and the resistance band anchored above your head (looped over a door or frame). Hold both ends of the band with your arms extended overhead.
end_pose_description: Pull the band down toward your chest by bending your elbows and driving them past your ribs. Squeeze your shoulder blades and lats at the bottom before slowly returning to the starting position.

name: Band Pull-Aparts
pose_description: Standing upright with arms extended in front at shoulder height, holding a resistance band with both hands slightly closer than shoulder-width apart. The hands pull the band apart by driving the arms outward and squeezing the shoulder blades together until the band touches the chest. The elbows stay straight and the shoulders remain depressed throughout.
end_pose_description: The person stands upright facing forward with both arms extended directly out to the sides at shoulder height, elbows locked straight, and the resistance band stretched across the chest touching or nearly touching the torso. The shoulder blades are visibly retracted and squeezed together, creating prominent definition across the upper back and rear deltoids, with the chest slightly expanded and shoulders pulled down away from the ears.

name: Band-Resisted Shoulder Abduction
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with a resistance band under both feet, holding the ends in each hand at your sides. Your arms are straight with the band taut and your posture is upright.
end_pose_description: Raise both arms out to your sides up to shoulder height against the band resistance, maintaining a slight elbow bend throughout. Your arms form a 90-degree angle with your torso at the peak of the movement.

name: Band Reverse Fly
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Hinge forward from your hips, keeping your back straight and your chest leaning towards the floor. Loop a resistance band under both feet and hold the handles with your arms hanging straight down, maintaining tension in the band.
end_pose_description: Raise both arms out to the sides and slightly backward in an arc, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your arms should finish at shoulder height with elbows slightly bent throughout the movement.

name: Banded Copenhagen Adductor Exercise
pose_description: Lie on your side, propped up on your forearm, with your hips stacked and body straight. Place your top leg, fully extended, with your shin resting on an elevated surface. Your bottom leg is extended straight below your top leg, with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees.
end_pose_description: Lift your bottom leg up toward your top knee against the band resistance, focusing on inner thigh contraction. Lower with control and repeat.

name: Banded External Rotation at 90/90
pose_description: Stand with your right arm abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding one end of a resistance band. Your forearm points downward and the band is anchored at shoulder height to your side.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm upward against the band resistance, keeping your elbow stationary at shoulder height. Your forearm finishes pointing upward, with the band providing controlled resistance throughout.

name: Banded Hip Internal Rotation
pose_description: Sit upright on a bench with both knees bent at 90 degrees and feet flat on the floor, with a resistance band looped around both feet. Maintain an upright posture with your core engaged.
end_pose_description: Keeping your right knee stationary, rotate your right foot inward against the band resistance, then return to center. Switch sides and repeat with controlled movements.

name: Banded Pull-Apart for Shoulder Stability
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band with both hands at chest height with arms extended straight out in front of you. Your shoulders should be relaxed and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward in an arc, squeezing your shoulder blades together and bringing your hands to shoulder width. Your arms should maintain a slight bend throughout the movement.

name: Banded Reverse Fly
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band held at chest height with both hands, arms bent and positioned in front of your body. Your shoulders should be relaxed and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Pull the band apart and outward by opening your arms to the sides, squeezing your rear shoulder muscles and upper back. Your arms should end in a T position with elbows slightly bent.

name: Banded Shoulder Stabilizer Series
pose_description: Standing upright holding a resistance band with both hands. The exercise cycles through multiple positions: band pull-aparts at chest height, external rotation with elbows at sides, overhead press against band tension, and diagonal patterns. Throughout each movement, the shoulder blades are actively set down and back, the core is engaged, and the posture remains tall and aligned.
end_pose_description: The person stands upright facing forward with shoulders pulled back and down, arms extended outward at shoulder height with the resistance band stretched wide across the chest, elbows slightly bent, and chest expanded with visible engagement through the upper back and rear deltoids. The core appears braced, spine neutral, and the entire posterior chain from shoulders through glutes shows tonal engagement against the band tension.

name: Banded Side-Lying Hip Adduction
pose_description: Lie on your side with a resistance band looped around both legs above the knees. Keep your bottom leg straight and your top leg bent with foot planted in front for stability.
end_pose_description: Lift your bottom leg upward against the band resistance, squeezing the inner thigh muscles. Hold briefly at the top before returning to the starting position.

name: BOSU Ball Balance
pose_description: Standing on the dome side of a BOSU ball with feet hip-width apart or on a single leg. The knees are slightly bent, the core is engaged, and the arms are at sides or extended for balance. The body works to maintain equilibrium on the unstable surface while keeping the torso upright and the gaze directed forward at a fixed point.
end_pose_description: The person stands tall and stationary on the dome side of the BOSU ball with feet hip-width apart (or balanced on a single leg), knees slightly bent to maintain stability, torso upright and aligned over the base of support, core visibly engaged through a neutral spine, and arms either extended outward at shoulder height or positioned for counterbalance. The gaze is fixed forward at a focal point, with visible muscle engagement through the legs (quadriceps and glutes), core, and stabilizer muscles working to resist any wobbling on the unstable surface.

name: Resistance Band Calf Raises
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped under the balls of both feet and holding the ends in your hands for tension. Your feet are hip-width apart and posture is tall.
end_pose_description: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels while pressing down through the band resistance. Pause at the top, feeling the engagement in your calves and the soles of your feet.

name: Calf Raises with Dumbbells
pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Your weight is evenly distributed across the balls and heels of your feet.
end_pose_description: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground while maintaining an upright posture. Hold briefly at the top before lowering back down with control.

name: Calf Stretch with Band Against Wall
pose_description: Stand facing a wall with one leg forward in a lunge position and the back leg straight. Loop a resistance band around the ball of the back foot, holding the ends for assistance.
end_pose_description: Lean gently forward, using the band to help keep your back heel grounded as you feel a stretch in the calf muscle of the back leg. Maintain an upright torso and steady breathing.

name: Calf Stretch with Band
pose_description: Sit with one leg extended and loop a resistance band around the ball of that foot, holding the ends in both hands. Keep your knee straight.
end_pose_description: Gently pull the band toward your body to flex your foot upward (dorsiflexion), feeling a stretch in the calf and achilles tendon area. Hold for 30 seconds.

name: Cervical Rotation Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and shoulders relaxed. Head is facing forward in neutral position.
end_pose_description: Slowly rotate your head to the right, turning your chin toward your shoulder while maintaining upright posture. Hold 20-30 seconds and repeat on opposite side.

name: Clam Shell Exercise with Band
pose_description: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent at 45 degrees and a resistance band above both knees. Keep your feet together and lower leg stable.
end_pose_description: Rotate your upper knee upward, opening it like a clamshell while keeping feet together. Pause at the top before closing back down.

name: Cross-Body Stretch
pose_description: Standing upright with one arm extended straight across the chest at shoulder height. The opposite hand cups the elbow or upper arm and gently pulls it closer to the body, creating a stretch across the posterior shoulder and upper back. The shoulders remain level and the torso does not twist.
end_pose_description: The person stands upright facing forward with one arm crossed horizontally across the chest at shoulder height, elbow bent approximately 90 degrees, while the opposite hand firmly grasps and pulls the crossed arm closer to the body, creating a visible compression across the posterior shoulder and upper back. The shoulders remain level and square, the spine stays neutral without rotation, and the stretched shoulder blade appears retracted as the chest and anterior shoulder muscles visibly lengthen on the pulling side.

name: Doorway Pec Stretch with Rotation
pose_description: Stand in a doorway with one arm raised to 90 degrees, elbow bent, and forearm resting against the doorframe. Step one foot forward slightly.
end_pose_description: Rotate your torso away from the raised arm, deepening the stretch across your chest and shoulder. Feel the stretch intensify through your pectoral muscles.

name: Dumbbell Deadlifts with Posterior Chain Focus
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms straight. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.
end_pose_description: Hinge at the hips while keeping your shins relatively vertical, lowering the dumbbells down the front of your legs. Feel a stretch in your hamstrings and calves as you descend, then drive through your heels to return to standing.

name: Dumbbell External Rotation at 90/90
pose_description: Lie on your back on a bench with your shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and your elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding a light dumbbell. Your upper arm is perpendicular to your body.
end_pose_description: Rotate the dumbbell upward, bringing your forearm toward vertical while keeping your upper arm stationary at 90 degrees of abduction. Slowly return to the neutral position.

name: Dumbbell Farmer Carry
pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one or both hands at your sides with your shoulders packed back and down. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
end_pose_description: Walk forward while maintaining shoulder stability and neutral spine, keeping the dumbbell(s) stable at your side. Maintain scapular control throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Farmer's Carry
pose_description: Stand upright with dumbbells held at your sides with a neutral grip and your shoulders packed down and back. Your core is engaged and your posture is tall.
end_pose_description: Walk forward while maintaining perfect upright posture with shoulders retracted and scapulae stabilized. Your arms remain straight at your sides throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squats
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Lower into a squat by bending your hips and knees, keeping the dumbbell at chest level and weight in your heels. Drive through your heels to return to standing, maintaining an upright posture throughout.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrusts
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a dumbbell resting across your hips. Your arms are at your sides for support.
end_pose_description: Drive through your heels and lift your hips high, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders while holding the dumbbell secure. Squeeze your glutes firmly at the top before lowering.

name: Dumbbell Pullovers
pose_description: Lie perpendicular across a bench with your upper back supported and feet on the floor, holding a single dumbbell with both hands above your chest. Your shoulders are in a relaxed position.
end_pose_description: Lower the dumbbell in an arc motion behind and above your head, allowing a stretch across your chest and anterior shoulder. Your hips remain on or near the bench throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlifts
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a slight bend in your knees. Your weight is distributed through the entire foot.
end_pose_description: Hinge at the hips while maintaining a neutral spine, lowering the dumbbells toward the ground and feeling a stretch in your hamstrings. Return to standing by driving through your feet.

name: Dumbbell Rows
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a slight forward hinge at the hips. Keep your core engaged and your back neutral.
end_pose_description: Pull both dumbbells up toward your ribcage, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top. Your elbows should stay close to your body throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Step-Ups
pose_description: Stand facing a low step or bench, holding dumbbells at your sides with a neutral grip. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Step up onto the bench with the unaffected leg first, then bring the affected leg up to meet it. Step back down with control, leading with the affected leg.

name: Dumbbell Step-Ups with Emphasis on Stance Leg Stability
pose_description: Stand facing a sturdy step or bench with dumbbells held at your sides. Place one foot on the step with your weight distributed evenly across the entire foot.
end_pose_description: Drive through your front heel to step up onto the bench, bringing your rear foot to meet it. Slowly step back down with control, emphasizing stability through the foot and ankle of your stance leg.

name: Dynamic Adductor Stretch with Hip Rotation
pose_description: Stand with feet wide apart in a staggered stance with hands on your hips. Keep your back straight and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Lunge toward one side while rotating your hips, feeling a dynamic stretch along the inner thigh. Return to center and alternate sides.

name: Eccentric Biceps Curl with Band
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored under your feet with both hands at shoulder height. Your elbows are bent at 90 degrees and tucked close to your torso.
end_pose_description: Slowly lower your hands toward your thighs in a controlled manner over 3-4 seconds, keeping your elbows stationary and close to your body. Your arms are nearly straight at the end of the eccentric phase.

name: Elbow Flexion with Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand upright with your arms at your sides, holding a light dumbbell in your affected arm with palm facing forward. Your elbow is fully extended but not locked.
end_pose_description: Bend your elbow to bring the dumbbell up toward your shoulder in a slow, controlled bicep curl motion. Lower the weight back down with control.

name: External Rotation
pose_description: Standing upright with the working arm bent at 90 degrees at the elbow, elbow pinned to the side of the body. A resistance band or light dumbbell is held in the hand. The forearm rotates outward away from the body while keeping the elbow firmly against the torso, moving through approximately 45 degrees of external rotation.
end_pose_description: The person stands upright facing forward with the working arm still bent 90 degrees at the elbow, pinned against the ribcage, but the forearm is rotated outward away from the centerline of the body at approximately 45 degrees. The forearm appears nearly perpendicular to the body's sagittal plane, with visible tension in the shoulder and upper back muscles, particularly the posterior deltoid and rotator cuff, while the opposite arm hangs relaxed at the side.

name: Foam Roller Calf
pose_description: Seated on the floor with legs extended and a foam roller positioned under both calves. Hands are placed behind the hips on the floor, lifting the buttocks slightly off the ground. The body rolls forward and backward, moving the roller from just above the ankles to below the knees, applying pressure along the calf muscles.
end_pose_description: The person is seated on the floor with their torso leaning slightly backward, arms extended behind them with hands pressing into the floor to support lifted hips, while both legs are extended and the foam roller is positioned at the furthest point of the roll (either fully toward the ankles or fully toward the knees, depending on direction). The calf muscles appear maximally engaged and compressed against the foam roller, with the body weight distributed between the hands and the roller contact point.

name: Foam Roller IT Band
pose_description: Lying on one side with a foam roller positioned under the outer thigh between the hip and the knee. The bottom leg is extended straight, and the top leg may cross over in front with the foot flat on the floor for support and pressure control. The hands and forearms support the upper body off the ground as the body rolls slowly up and down the roller along the IT band.
end_pose_description: The person is positioned on their side with the foam roller pressed firmly into the upper outer thigh/hip area, body weight supported through forearms and hands on the ground. The bottom leg is fully extended straight along the ground, while the top leg is crossed over with knee bent and foot planted in front of the body for stability, creating a stacked side-lying position. The IT band, glute medius, and hip stabilizer muscles appear engaged and compressed against the roller.

name: Foam Roller Quad
pose_description: Lying face down in a modified plank position with a foam roller positioned under the front of both thighs. The forearms support the upper body, and the toes may be off the ground. The body rolls slowly forward and backward, moving the roller from just above the kneecaps to the hip flexors, applying pressure to the quadriceps.
end_pose_description: The person is in a prone plank position with forearms flat on the ground, elbows bent at approximately 90 degrees, and the foam roller positioned at the highest point on the thighs near the hip flexors. The body is nearly horizontal and parallel to the ground with core muscles visibly engaged, legs extended straight behind with toes lightly touching or hovering, and the quadriceps appear compressed and engaged against the roller as the upper body weight presses down through the forearms.

name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
pose_description: Lying on back with a foam roller positioned horizontally under the mid-back at the level of the shoulder blades. Knees are bent with feet flat on the floor, and hands are clasped behind the head to support the neck. The upper back gently arches over the roller, extending the thoracic spine while the hips remain on the floor.
end_pose_description: The person lies on their back with the foam roller positioned under the mid-back, their chest prominently arched backward in maximum thoracic extension while hips remain planted on the floor and knees stay bent with feet flat. The hands remain clasped behind the head with elbows spread wide, and the head gently extends back without straining the neck, creating a pronounced C-curve through the upper spine that stretches the chest and anterior shoulders. The abdominal and hip flexor muscles appear lengthened while the upper back musculature is visibly engaged around the roller.

name: Forearm Pronation/Supination with Band
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, upper arm against your body, palm facing down with a resistance band in your hand. Your forearm is parallel to the ground.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm so your palm faces upward against light band resistance, then rotate back to palms down. Move slowly through the full range of motion.

name: Glute Kickbacks with Dumbbell
pose_description: Start in a tabletop position with a dumbbell resting in the crease of your right knee. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral throughout.
end_pose_description: Drive your right leg backward and upward, extending your hip while keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees. Squeeze your glute at the top before returning to start position.

name: Gentle Grip Strengthening with Dumbbell
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your arm resting on your lap, holding a light dumbbell with a neutral grip. Your hand is relaxed at the starting position.
end_pose_description: Gently squeeze your fingers around the dumbbell, creating moderate tension without pain. Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds before releasing to the starting position.

name: Half-Kneeling Shoulder Rotations with Band
pose_description: In a half-kneeling position with one knee on the floor and the opposite foot flat in front, hip and knee at 90 degrees. A resistance band is anchored to the side, and the working arm is bent at 90 degrees at the elbow with the elbow at the side. The forearm rotates outward against the band and returns inward, training external rotation. The torso remains tall and the core is engaged.
end_pose_description: The person remains in half-kneeling position with torso upright and squared forward, while the working arm is rotated outward so the forearm points away from the body at approximately 90 degrees of external rotation at the shoulder, with the elbow still bent at 90 degrees and tucked at the side. The resistance band is fully stretched, creating visible tension across the front of the shoulder and chest, with the rotator cuff and shoulder stabilizers visibly engaged.

name: Hamstring Stretch with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with one leg bent and one leg extended. Loop a resistance band around the foot of the extended leg.
end_pose_description: Gently pull the band toward your torso to straighten the leg and deepen the hamstring stretch. Keep your lower back flat on the floor throughout.

name: Hip Abduction with Resistance Band
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Keep a slight bend in both knees for stability.
end_pose_description: Step the affected leg out to the side against the band resistance, maintaining an upright posture. Return to starting position with controlled movement.

name: Hip Abduction with Band
pose_description: Lie on your side with legs extended and a resistance band looped around both thighs. Keep your torso stable and your lower leg as a base.
end_pose_description: Lift your top leg upward against the band resistance, maintaining a straight alignment. Lower down without touching your legs together and repeat.

name: Seated Hip External Rotation with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with one ankle crossed over the opposite knee, forming a figure-4 position. Place a resistance band around the knee of the raised leg.
end_pose_description: Gently press the raised knee outward against the band resistance, rotating at the hip to open up the hip flexor and external rotators. Maintain an upright posture throughout the movement.

name: Internal Rotation
pose_description: Standing upright with the working arm bent at 90 degrees at the elbow, elbow pinned to the side of the body. A resistance band or cable is held in the hand. The forearm rotates inward across the body toward the stomach, working the internal rotators of the shoulder. The elbow stays firmly at the side throughout the movement.
end_pose_description: The person stands upright facing forward with the working arm bent at 90 degrees at the elbow, forearm rotated inward across the front of the body toward the midline/stomach, with the elbow remaining pinned against the ribcage. The shoulder internal rotators and anterior chest muscles appear visibly engaged and contracted, creating tension across the front shoulder and chest.

name: Inversion/Eversion with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg extended, a resistance band looped around the ball of your foot. Your knee remains straight and stable throughout.
end_pose_description: Turn your foot inward (inversion) and outward (eversion) against the band resistance, moving through a comfortable range. Control the movement in both directions.

name: Isometric Shoulder External Rotation
pose_description: Standing next to a wall or doorframe with the elbow bent at 90 degrees and pinned against the side. The back of the wrist or hand presses outward into the wall or doorframe with sustained effort, as if trying to externally rotate the shoulder. No visible movement occurs — the contraction is purely isometric. The torso remains upright.
end_pose_description: The person stands upright facing perpendicular to the wall, with their right elbow bent at 90 degrees and pressed firmly against their ribcage, while their wrist and forearm are pressed outward against the wall in external rotation—the shoulder and rotator cuff muscles visibly tensed and engaged. The torso remains perfectly still and aligned vertically, with the opposite arm at rest, and the face looks straight ahead as sustained isometric tension is held through the shoulder external rotators.

name: Isometric Shoulder Internal Rotation
pose_description: Standing next to a wall or doorframe with the elbow bent at 90 degrees and pinned against the side. The palm or front of the wrist presses inward into the wall or doorframe with sustained effort, as if trying to internally rotate the shoulder. No visible movement occurs — the contraction is purely isometric. The torso remains upright.
end_pose_description: The person stands upright facing perpendicular to the wall, with their right elbow bent at 90 degrees and pressed firmly against their ribcage, while their forearm and palm are pressed inward against the wall with maximum isometric tension. The shoulder and chest muscles on the working side appear visibly contracted and engaged, with the torso remaining stable and squared, demonstrating sustained internal rotation force against the immovable surface.

name: IT Band Foam Roll Stretch
pose_description: Sit on the ground and position a foam roller under your right hip, with your right leg extended over the roller. Support yourself with your hands behind you.
end_pose_description: Roll your body weight forward and backward along the IT band from hip to just above the knee, pausing on tender points for 20-30 seconds.

name: IT Band Stretch
pose_description: Standing upright with legs crossed, the back leg crossing behind the front leg. The body leans to the side of the front leg, pushing the hip of the back leg outward while reaching the arm overhead toward the opposite side. A stretch is felt along the outer thigh and hip of the back leg.
end_pose_description: The person stands with their right leg crossed behind their left leg, torso leaning distinctly to the left with the left arm stretched overhead and reaching diagonally across toward the right side, creating a pronounced lateral flexion curve from hip to fingertips. The right hip is pushed outward and back, the left knee maintains a slight bend, and the head follows the spinal curve while facing forward, with the outer right thigh and hip visibly lengthened.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch with Band
pose_description: Kneel on one knee with the other foot planted in front, creating a 90-degree angle at both hips. A resistance band is looped around the back knee for gentle assistance.
end_pose_description: Gently press your hips forward while using the band to support and deepen the hip flexor stretch on the kneeling side. Maintain an upright torso and avoid arching your lower back excessively.

name: Lat Pulldown with Band
pose_description: Seated in a chair or on the floor with a resistance band anchored overhead. Both hands grip the band wider than shoulder-width with palms facing forward. The elbows pull downward and back, driving the band toward the upper chest while squeezing the shoulder blades together. The torso remains upright and the core stays engaged.
end_pose_description: The person is seated upright with elbows bent at approximately 90 degrees, positioned close to the ribcage with upper arms nearly vertical and forearms angled slightly forward. The resistance band is pulled down to upper chest level with both hands roughly shoulder-width apart, shoulder blades visibly retracted and depressed, creating prominent definition across the lats, rhomboids, and upper back. The torso remains perpendicular to the ground with chest slightly lifted, facing directly forward.

name: Lateral Band Walks
pose_description: Standing in a quarter-squat position with a resistance band looped around the ankles or just above the knees. Feet are shoulder-width apart with knees bent and hips hinged slightly. Steps are taken laterally, leading with one foot and following with the other, maintaining constant tension on the band. The torso stays upright and the knees do not cave inward.
end_pose_description: The figure stands in a wide quarter-squat stance with one leg fully extended laterally while the other remains bent, creating maximum horizontal separation between the feet and maximum tension on the resistance band. The torso remains upright and centered, knees stay aligned over toes (no inward collapse), and the glutes, hip abductors, and quadriceps are visibly engaged and contracted as the stepping leg reaches its furthest lateral position. The person faces forward with shoulders level and square to the camera.

name: Lateral Lunge with Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand with feet together holding a dumbbell at chest height with both hands. Maintain an upright torso and engaged core.
end_pose_description: Step your right foot out to the side, shifting your weight onto that leg and lowering into a deep lateral lunge. Keep your left leg straight and return to standing by pushing through your right heel.

name: Lateral Side-Lying Clam Shell
pose_description: Lying on one side with hips bent to approximately 45 degrees and knees bent to 90 degrees, feet stacked together. The bottom arm extends under the head, and the top hand rests on the hip. The top knee opens upward like a clamshell while the feet stay together and the pelvis remains stable without rolling backward. A resistance band may be placed just above the knees.
end_pose_description: The person lies on their side with the top knee opened maximally upward (approximately 70-90 degrees), creating a wide angle between the two knees while the feet remain pressed together and the pelvis stays stable without rotating backward. The hip and glute muscles on the upper side are visibly engaged and contracted, while the lower body maintains its 45-degree hip bend and 90-degree knee bend position.

name: Lumbar Rotation Stretch
pose_description: Lying flat on back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Both knees drop together to one side toward the floor while the shoulders and upper back remain flat on the ground. The arms are extended out to the sides in a T position for stability. The head may turn to look toward the opposite side of the knees.
end_pose_description: The person lies supine with their torso flat against the ground while both knees are dropped maximally toward the floor on one side, creating a 45-60 degree angle at the hips. Their shoulders remain pressed flat on the ground perpendicular to their lower body, with arms extended outward in a T-position, and their head is turned to face the opposite direction of the dropped knees. The oblique and rotational muscles along the torso appear stretched and elongated across the twist created between the upper and lower body.

name: Peroneal Tendon Glide with Band
pose_description: Sit with one leg extended and wrap a band around your foot at the base of the toes. Support your calf with your other hand for stability.
end_pose_description: Slowly plantarflex your foot (point toes away) while maintaining light band tension, promoting tendon mobility and reducing stiffness. Return to neutral and repeat.

name: Plantar Fascia Stretch with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with one leg extended in front of you or crossed over the opposite knee. Wrap a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding both ends of the band in your hands.
end_pose_description: Gently pull the band toward your body, flexing your toes back toward your shin while keeping your leg relatively straight. Hold the stretch feeling gentle tension along the bottom of your foot and arch.

name: Posterior Shoulder Stretch with Band
pose_description: Stand upright, facing forward, with feet hip-width apart. Hold one end of a resistance band in your right hand and the other end in your left hand. Your right arm is extended across the front of your body at chest height, with a slight bend in the elbow, while your left hand holds the band near your left hip.
end_pose_description: Pull the band apart by moving your hands away from each other, opening your chest and squeezing your shoulder blades back. Your arms remain at chest height with the stretch felt across your chest and front shoulders.

name: Pronation/Supination with Light Dumbbell
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your torso, holding a light dumbbell with a neutral grip (handshake position). Your forearm is parallel to the ground.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm to turn the palm upward (supination) or downward (pronation), moving only at the wrist and forearm. Return to neutral and repeat in the opposite direction.

name: Pronation and Supination with Light Weight
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent 90 degrees and supported on a table, holding a light dumbbell (2-3 lbs) with a neutral grip. Your forearm is horizontal.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm so your palm faces down (pronation), then reverse to palm facing up (supination). Control the movement throughout the full range of motion.

name: Prone Hip Internal Rotation
pose_description: Lie face down with your right leg bent at the knee with your foot positioned to the right side of your body. Your left leg remains extended, and your forehead rests on your hands.
end_pose_description: Gently press your right knee toward the floor, rotating your hip internally to increase the stretch. Hold this position while maintaining a neutral spine and relaxed shoulders.

name: Prone I-Y-T Shoulder Series with Band
pose_description: Lie face down on a bench or sturdy surface with feet on ground, holding light resistance band in both hands at shoulder height. Forehead rests on a small towel.
end_pose_description: Pull band outward and upward in an I position (arms overhead), then Y position (45 degrees), then T position (90 degrees), holding each briefly before returning. Perform 10-12 reps of each position.

name: Prone Lumbar Extension with Band
pose_description: Lie face down on the floor with your forearms on the ground, elbows under your shoulders. A resistance band is looped around your mid-back and anchored securely beneath you.
end_pose_description: Push through your forearms and gently lift your chest off the ground while the band provides resistance. Hold this extended position while maintaining a neutral spine and avoiding excessive arching.

name: Prone Shoulder Abduction (Dumbbell)
pose_description: Lie face down on a bench or inclined surface with your affected arm hanging down toward the floor. Hold a light dumbbell in your affected hand with your arm in a neutral position.
end_pose_description: Raise the dumbbell out to the side, lifting your arm to shoulder height in an abduction motion. Keep your elbow slightly bent and move slowly with control, avoiding momentum.

name: Prone Shoulder Extension with Band
pose_description: Lie face down on a table or bed with your arms hanging down toward the floor, holding a light resistance band in both hands. Your forehead rests on the table and your core is engaged.
end_pose_description: Raise your arms out to your sides and slightly back, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement. Your arms form a gentle arc and your chest stays on the table throughout.

name: Prone Shoulder External Rotation
pose_description: Lie face down on a flat bench with your affected arm hanging off the side, elbow bent at 90 degrees with a light dumbbell in hand. Your upper arm should be parallel to the ground.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm upward by externally rotating your shoulder, bringing the dumbbell toward the ceiling. Hold briefly at the top, then lower back to the starting position.

name: Prone Shoulder Stability Ball Y-Raises
pose_description: Lie face down over a stability ball with your chest supported and your feet anchored on the floor. Your arms hang straight down with a light dumbbell in each hand.
end_pose_description: Raise both arms out to the sides and slightly forward in a 'Y' position to shoulder height, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Lower the dumbbells back down in a controlled manner.

name: Quadriceps Stretch with Band
pose_description: Stand upright and place a resistance band around one foot. Hold both ends of the band with your hands at chest height.
end_pose_description: Gently pull the band to bring your heel toward your glutes, feeling a stretch along the front of the thigh. Keep your knees parallel and avoid arching your lower back.

name: Quadruped Band Row
pose_description: Begin on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around your hands, maintaining a neutral spine and engaged core. Your hands should be shoulder-width apart with the band slack.
end_pose_description: Row one hand back by pulling the band, retracting your shoulder blade while keeping your torso stable and level. Your elbow should track close to your ribcage as you pull.

name: Quadruped Hip Circles
pose_description: Begin on hands and knees with a neutral spine, wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Engage your core to maintain stability throughout the movement.
end_pose_description: Lift one knee slightly off the ground and make slow, controlled circles, moving through the hip joint's full range of motion. Complete the desired number of circles in both directions before switching legs.

name: Quadruped Hip Extension
pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Extend one leg backward and upward, lifting your knee away from the floor while keeping the hip level. Squeeze your glutes at the top before lowering back down.

name: Quadruped Hip Flexor March
pose_description: On hands and knees in tabletop position with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. One knee lifts slightly off the floor, driving the thigh upward in a marching motion while the hands remain planted. The movement alternates legs in a slow marching pattern. The spine remains neutral, the hips stay level, and the core is braced to prevent shifting.
end_pose_description: The performer is in quadruped position with one thigh driven upward to approximately hip height, knee bent at roughly 90 degrees, while the opposite leg remains extended and planted on the ground. The torso remains parallel to the ground with a neutral spine, shoulders stacked over wrists, and the pelvis stays level and square without rotation—the abdominals appear visibly engaged and braced. The lifted knee hovers several inches above the floor while the supporting arm and leg create stable anchor points.

name: Quadruped Hip Flexor Stretch
pose_description: Start on hands and knees with shoulders over wrists and hips over knees. Maintain a neutral spine position.
end_pose_description: Slide one leg backward while dropping the hip toward the floor, creating a lunge-like position. Keep your core engaged and feel the stretch along the front of the back hip.

name: Quadruped Opposite Arm and Leg Raise
pose_description: Begin on hands and knees with a neutral spine, ensuring shoulders are over wrists and hips are over knees. Brace your core to stabilize your lumbar spine.
end_pose_description: Simultaneously raise your right arm and left leg to shoulder and hip height respectively while maintaining a level spine. Hold for 2 seconds and return to start.

name: Quadruped Pelvic Tilts
pose_description: On hands and knees in tabletop position with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. The pelvis tilts posteriorly by tucking the tailbone under and rounding the lower back slightly, then anteriorly by arching the lower back and tilting the tailbone upward. The movement is isolated to the lumbar spine and pelvis while the upper back and shoulders remain still.
end_pose_description: From a side profile view, the person is in quadruped position with arms vertical and legs at 90-degree angles. The lower back is maximally arched with the tailbone pointed upward, the pelvis tilted anteriorly, and the chest lifted slightly forward—the abdominal muscles appear relaxed while the lower back extensors and hip flexors are visibly engaged. The head maintains neutral alignment following the spine's natural curve, and the shoulders remain stable directly over the wrists.

name: Quadruped Rock Backs
pose_description: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine and core engaged. Hands are directly under shoulders and knees under hips.
end_pose_description: Gently shift your hips back toward your heels while maintaining neutral spine alignment. Return to the starting position in a controlled manner.

name: Quadruped Rocking
pose_description: On hands and knees in tabletop position with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. The hips push backward toward the heels in a rocking motion, sitting back as far as comfortably possible while the hands remain on the floor. The spine stays neutral and the movement is slow and rhythmic, stretching the hips and lower back.
end_pose_description: The person is seated back on their heels in a deep hip flexion position, with arms extended forward and straight, hands still planted on the floor, creating a long diagonal line from the extended arms through the neutral spine. The hips are maximally retracted toward the heels, knees remain bent at approximately 90 degrees, and the head stays neutral with the gaze directed downward, with visible lengthening through the lower back, lats, and shoulders.

name: Quadruped Scapular Push-Up Plus
pose_description: Begin on hands and knees with hands directly under shoulders and knees under hips, maintaining a neutral spine. Your core is engaged and shoulders are packed down.
end_pose_description: Protract your scapulae by pushing the floor away, allowing your mid-back to round slightly upward between your shoulder blades. Hold this protraction position briefly before returning to the starting position.

name: Quadruped Shoulder Blade Squeeze
pose_description: Start on hands and knees with shoulders directly over wrists and hips over knees. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Retract your shoulder blades by squeezing them together and slightly depressing them. Maintain this contraction while keeping your arms stable and spine neutral.

name: Quadruped Shoulder Stability (Modified)
pose_description: Get on your hands and knees with your hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral with your head aligned with your spine.
end_pose_description: Gently shift your weight forward and backward while maintaining stability in your shoulders. This controlled movement builds dynamic stability without excessive load on the healing rotator cuff.

name: Quadruped Shoulder Stability Hold
pose_description: Position yourself on hands and knees with shoulders directly over wrists and hips over knees. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Slowly lift one arm forward to shoulder height while maintaining stability through your supporting arm and torso. Hold for 2-3 seconds, then return and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Quadruped Shoulder Taps
pose_description: On hands and knees in tabletop position with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips, or in a high plank position. One hand lifts off the floor and taps the opposite shoulder, then returns to the ground. The movement alternates sides. The hips remain level without rocking side to side, and the core is braced to prevent rotation.
end_pose_description: One arm is bent at the elbow and crosses the body to tap the opposite shoulder, while the supporting arm remains straight and locked beneath the shoulder, with the body held in a rigid plank position parallel to the ground. The hips and shoulders remain level and square, showing strong engagement through the obliques and core stabilizers, with the torso resisting any rotation despite the asymmetrical arm position.

name: Quadruped Spinal Rotation
pose_description: Begin on your hands and knees with shoulders over wrists and hips over knees. Place your right hand behind your head with elbow pointing out.
end_pose_description: Rotate your torso to bring your right elbow toward your left knee, creating a gentle twist through your thoracic spine. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotation
pose_description: On hands and knees in tabletop position. One hand is placed behind the head with the elbow pointing out to the side. The torso rotates, driving the elbow toward the opposite hand on the floor (closing), then rotates upward, driving the elbow toward the ceiling (opening). The hips remain square over the knees and the rotation occurs through the thoracic spine.
end_pose_description: The person is in quadruped position with the torso rotated maximally upward, the elbow that was behind the head now pointing toward the ceiling with the arm bent at approximately 90 degrees, while the gaze follows the elevated elbow. The opposite arm remains extended and planted on the floor, supporting the body weight, while the hips stay square and aligned over the knees with no rotation. The thoracic spine shows pronounced rotation and extension, with the ribcage visibly twisted open and the chest facing toward the elevated side.

name: Resistance Band Ankle Eversion
pose_description: Standing or seated with a resistance band looped around the outside of the forefoot, anchored to a fixed point on the opposite side. The foot pushes outward against the band resistance, turning the sole of the foot away from the midline of the body. The lower leg remains stationary and the movement occurs purely at the ankle joint.
end_pose_description: The foot is maximally turned outward (everted), with the sole of the foot facing laterally away from the body's midline, while the knee remains straight and the lower leg stays stationary. The resistance band is fully stretched, pulling against the outer edge of the forefoot, and the lateral ankle and peroneal muscles along the outer shin appear visibly engaged and contracted.

name: Resistance Band Ankle Inversion
pose_description: Standing or seated with a resistance band looped around the inside of the forefoot, anchored to a fixed point on the same side. The foot pulls inward against the band resistance, turning the sole of the foot toward the midline of the body. The lower leg remains stationary and the movement occurs purely at the ankle joint.
end_pose_description: The foot is maximally inverted with the sole turned inward toward the body's midline, creating a pronounced angle at the ankle joint while the lower leg remains completely still and vertical. The resistance band is visibly taut and stretched, demonstrating full tension against the inward foot position. The tibialis anterior and other anterior tibial muscles appear contracted and defined along the front of the lower leg.

name: Resistance Band Dorsiflexion
pose_description: Sit upright with your affected leg extended or slightly bent. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot and hold both ends, with tension already in the band.
end_pose_description: Pull your toes toward your shin against the band resistance, flexing at the ankle while keeping your leg stable. Hold briefly, then slowly lower back to the starting position.

name: Resistance Band External Rotation
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light resistance band in your affected hand. Your elbow is bent to 90 degrees and tucked against your ribcage with the band anchored to a fixed point at elbow height.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm outward against the band resistance, keeping your elbow stationary at your side. Return to the starting position in a controlled manner without allowing the band to snap back.

name: Resistance Band External Rotation at 90/90
pose_description: Standing upright with the working arm abducted to 90 degrees and the elbow bent to 90 degrees, forming a goalpost position. A resistance band is anchored at elbow height. The forearm rotates upward from a position pointing down toward the floor to a position pointing toward the ceiling, externally rotating the shoulder while maintaining the 90/90 arm position. The elbow stays at shoulder height throughout.
end_pose_description: The person stands upright facing forward with their working arm held at 90/90 position (shoulder abducted 90 degrees, elbow bent 90 degrees), and the forearm has externally rotated upward so it points toward the ceiling, creating a goalpost shape with the upper arm remaining parallel to the ground. The opposite arm hangs naturally at their side, and the torso remains stable and upright with visible engagement in the shoulder rotators and upper back musculature.

name: Resistance Band Hip Abduction
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Maintain a slight bend in both knees and keep your chest upright.
end_pose_description: Step laterally to one side, keeping tension on the band throughout the movement. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

name: Resistance Band Hip Flexion
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around one foot and holding the other end in both hands at waist height. Keep your standing leg straight with a slight knee bend.
end_pose_description: Pull your foot upward against the band resistance, lifting your knee toward your chest in a controlled motion. Maintain an upright posture and return slowly to the starting position.

name: Resistance Band Knee Extensions
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your back supported and both feet flat on the floor, knees bent at approximately 90 degrees. Loop a resistance band around the ankle of one leg and anchor the other end securely to a stable object positioned behind that foot, creating slight tension.
end_pose_description: Straighten your leg against the band resistance, extending the knee fully. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

name: Resistance Band Lateral Walks
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place a resistance band around your thighs just above the knees. Maintain a slight bend in your knees and a neutral spine.
end_pose_description: Step sideways, maintaining tension in the band and keeping your chest upright. Return to center and repeat in the opposite direction.

name: Resistance Band Plantarflexion
pose_description: Sit upright with your affected leg extended or slightly bent in front of you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot and hold both ends with tension in the band.
end_pose_description: Press your foot downward and away from your body against the band resistance, pointing your toes. Hold briefly, then return slowly to the starting position with control.

name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
pose_description: Standing upright with arms extended straight in front at shoulder height, holding a resistance band with both hands about shoulder-width apart. The hands pull the band apart horizontally by squeezing the shoulder blades together, stretching the band across the chest until the arms are out to the sides. The elbows remain straight throughout.
end_pose_description: The person stands upright facing forward with both arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height, forming a T-shape with the body, while holding a stretched resistance band with elbows locked in full extension. The shoulder blades are visibly retracted and squeezed together, creating prominent definition across the upper back and rear deltoids, with the chest lifted and shoulders drawn back.

name: Resistance Band Shoulder External Rotation
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at chest height with elbow bent 90 degrees at your side. Band is looped around hands.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm outward against band resistance, keeping elbow stationary at your side. Hold briefly, then return to start position.

name: Resistance Band Shoulder Internal Rotation
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding resistance band with elbow bent 90 degrees and forearm rotated outward. Band is anchored at chest height.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm inward against band resistance, keeping elbow stationary. Hold briefly, then return to start position.

name: Resisted Back Extension with Band
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band looped around a fixed point at chest height in front of you. Hold both ends of the band with arms extended forward at chest level, maintaining neutral spine.
end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your torso by squeezing your shoulder blades together and extending your thoracic spine slightly backward. Hold this retracted position while keeping your core engaged and lower back neutral.

name: Resisted Foot Eversion in Side-Lying
pose_description: Lie on your unaffected side with your bottom leg bent for stability and your top leg extended. Loop the band around both feet just above the toes.
end_pose_description: Lift your top foot upward and outward against the band resistance, isolating the peroneal muscles. Lower with control and repeat.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl with Dumbbell
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing upward, holding a light dumbbell. Your wrist hangs slightly beyond the edge with the dumbbell at the starting position.
end_pose_description: Curl your wrist upward, lifting the dumbbell toward your body using only wrist motion. Pause briefly at the top before lowering the weight back to the starting position.

name: Scapular Retraction with Band
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at chest height with both hands in front of you. Your arms are extended forward with a slight bend in the elbows and the band is taut.
end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together, keeping your elbows high and level with your shoulders. Your chest is open and your posture is upright at the end of the movement.

name: Scapular Squeeze with Band
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a looped resistance band at chest height with arms extended at shoulder width. Maintain neutral spine.
end_pose_description: Pull band outward by squeezing shoulder blades together, keeping arms at shoulder height. Hold briefly, then return to start with controlled motion.

name: Seated Adductor Squeeze with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a resistance band between your knees, just above them, ensuring it is held firmly in place.
end_pose_description: Squeeze your knees together against the band resistance, engaging the inner thigh muscles. Maintain the squeeze for 2 seconds before releasing.

name: Seated Ankle Dorsiflexion with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your leg extended, a resistance band looped around the ball of your foot. Keep your knee straight and stable.
end_pose_description: Pull your toes toward your shin against the resistance of the band, creating tension in the front of the ankle. Hold briefly at the top of the range of motion.

name: Seated Ankle Inversion with Band
pose_description: Sit with your legs extended in front of you on the floor or a bench. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding both ends with your hands.
end_pose_description: Pull your foot inward (inversion) against the band resistance, creating tension through the peroneal tendons. Hold briefly at the end range of motion.

name: Seated Dorsiflexion with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit upright with one leg extended and a resistance band looped around the ball of your foot, holding the band ends in both hands. Keep your knee slightly bent.
end_pose_description: Pull your toes toward your shin against the band resistance, creating tension in your shin muscles. Hold the contraction briefly before returning to the start position.

name: Seated Foot Inversion with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot with the other end anchored to a stable object at ankle height on the inside of your foot.
end_pose_description: Slowly turn the sole of your foot inward (inversion), creating tension against the resistance band. Hold for 1-2 seconds at the end range of motion while maintaining control.

name: Seated Hip External Rotation
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg crossed over your opposite knee, forming a figure-4 position. Keep your back straight and posture neutral.
end_pose_description: Gently lean forward from the hips to deepen the stretch on the outer hip and glute of the crossed leg. Maintain steady breathing and hold the position without bouncing.

name: Seated Hip Internal Rotation
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor and knees bent to 90 degrees. Keep your back straight and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Slowly rotate one knee inward across the body, internally rotating at the hip joint while keeping your foot off the floor. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Seated Hip Internal Rotation Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor and good posture. Keep your core gently engaged and shoulders relaxed.
end_pose_description: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and gently press the raised knee downward while leaning slightly forward. Feel the stretch in the outer hip and glute of the raised leg.

name: Seated Hip Internal Rotation Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright on the floor with one leg extended and the other knee bent, foot placed on the outside of the extended knee. Keep your back straight and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Gently twist your torso toward the bent knee, using your opposite arm to increase the stretch. Hold the position while maintaining an upright posture.

name: Seated Row with Band
pose_description: Seated on the floor with legs extended straight in front and a resistance band looped around the feet. Both hands grip the band with palms facing each other. The elbows pull straight back, squeezing the shoulder blades together, drawing the hands toward the lower ribs. The torso remains upright and does not lean backward.
end_pose_description: The person is seated upright with legs extended straight, elbows bent at approximately 90 degrees and pulled tightly against the ribcage, with hands drawn back toward the lower chest/ribs while maintaining a neutral spine. The shoulder blades are visibly retracted and squeezed together, the chest is slightly puffed forward, and the back musculature (lats and rhomboids) appears maximally contracted and engaged. The resistance band remains taut between the looped feet and the hands at the end position.

name: Seated Shoulder Shrugs with Dumbbell
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with good posture and feet flat on the floor. Hold a light dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides and shoulders in a neutral, relaxed position.
end_pose_description: Elevate both shoulders toward your ears by contracting your trapezius muscles. Hold briefly at the top, then lower slowly back to the starting position with control.

name: Seated Spinal Rotation
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and good posture, keeping your hips and pelvis stable. Cross your arms over your chest or place hands behind your head.
end_pose_description: Gently rotate your upper spine and torso to one side, feeling a controlled stretch through the mid-back. Keep your hips still and return to center before rotating to the other side.

name: Seated Spinal Stretch with Band
pose_description: Sit upright on the floor with legs extended in front of you. Loop a resistance band around both feet and hold the ends loosely in your hands.
end_pose_description: Gently fold forward at the hips while keeping your back straight, using the band to deepen the stretch along your hamstrings and lower back. Hold this position and breathe deeply.

name: Seated Spinal Twist
pose_description: Seated on the floor with one leg extended straight and the other leg crossed over with the foot flat on the floor outside the opposite knee. The torso rotates toward the bent knee, and the opposite elbow hooks outside the bent knee for leverage. The sitting bones remain grounded, the spine stays tall, and the rotation comes from the thoracic and lumbar spine.
end_pose_description: The torso is rotated maximally toward the bent knee, with the spine twisted from the thoracic spine, while the head follows the rotation to gaze over the shoulder. The hooked elbow presses against the outside of the bent knee for leverage, the extended leg remains straight on the floor, the opposite arm reaches behind for balance or wraps around the torso, and the sitting bones stay planted as the obliques and spinal rotators appear fully engaged and lengthened on the extended side.

name: Seated Trunk Rotation
pose_description: Seated in a chair with feet flat on the floor and knees bent at 90 degrees. A stick, band, or the arms crossed over the chest provide a reference. The torso rotates to one side as far as comfortably possible, then returns to center and rotates to the other side. The hips and knees remain fixed forward while the rotation comes from the thoracic and lumbar spine.
end_pose_description: The seated figure is rotated maximally to one side with the torso twisted at approximately 45-90 degrees from center, while the hips and lower body remain square to the front with feet flat and knees bent at 90 degrees. The arms are either crossed over the chest or holding a stick/band parallel to the shoulders, pointing perpendicular to the direction the torso faces. The oblique and spinal rotator muscles on the rotating side appear engaged and shortened, while those on the opposite side appear lengthened and stretched.

name: Side-Lying Clamshell with Band
pose_description: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent at 45 degrees, a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Keep your feet together and your bottom arm supporting your head.
end_pose_description: Open your top knee against the band resistance while keeping your feet together and hips stable. Pause at the top before slowly returning to the starting position.

name: Side-Lying External Rotation
pose_description: Lying on the uninvolved side with the working arm on top. The elbow of the top arm is bent to 90 degrees and pinned against the side with a small towel roll between the elbow and the ribcage. A light dumbbell is held in the hand, and the forearm rotates upward toward the ceiling, externally rotating the shoulder. The elbow remains stationary throughout.
end_pose_description: The person lies on their side with the working arm's elbow still bent at 90 degrees and anchored against the ribcage, while the forearm is rotated upward so the dumbbell points toward the ceiling, creating a vertical line from elbow to hand. The shoulder is externally rotated maximally, with the posterior shoulder and rotator cuff muscles visibly engaged and contracted. The torso remains stable and flat against the ground, perpendicular to the floor.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
pose_description: Lying on one side with the body in a straight line, bottom arm extended under the head for support. The top leg lifts straight upward toward the ceiling to approximately 30 to 45 degrees while keeping the knee straight and toes pointed forward. The hips remain stacked and do not roll forward or backward.
end_pose_description: The person lies on their side in a straight line, with the top leg raised to approximately 45-60 degrees from the body, knee fully extended and toes pointed forward, while the bottom leg remains straight on the ground. The torso stays upright and stacked vertically above the bottom leg, with the bottom arm extended under the head and the top arm resting along the side of the torso. The abductor muscles on the outer hip and thigh of the top leg are visibly contracted and engaged, creating a defined line from hip to knee.

name: Side-Lying Shoulder Abduction
pose_description: Lie on your unaffected side with your bottom arm bent for support and your head resting comfortably. Your affected arm should rest on your side with a slight bend in the elbow.
end_pose_description: Lift your affected arm up toward the ceiling in a controlled motion, keeping your torso stable and avoiding any rolling backward. Lower the arm back down with control.

name: Side-Lying Shoulder Internal Rotation
pose_description: Lie on your unaffected side with your affected shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees. Hold a light dumbbell in your affected hand with your forearm pointing upward.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm downward toward your torso, moving only at the shoulder's internal rotators. Keep your elbow fixed and shoulder stable throughout the movement.

name: Side Plank
pose_description: Body supported on one forearm and the side of the bottom foot, forming a straight line from head to feet. The supporting elbow is directly under the shoulder, the top arm rests on the hip or extends toward the ceiling. The hips are lifted high and do not sag toward the floor, and the core is fully engaged.
end_pose_description: The body forms a perfectly straight diagonal line from head to feet, balanced on the supporting forearm (elbow bent 90 degrees directly beneath the shoulder) and the outer edge of the bottom foot, with hips lifted high and aligned with shoulders and ankles. The top leg is fully extended and stacked directly over the bottom leg, while the top arm either rests along the torso or extends upward, with the entire lateral core, obliques, and shoulder stabilizers visibly contracted and tensioned. The head maintains neutral alignment with the spine, facing forward, with no sagging at the hips or rotation of the torso.

name: Sidelying Hip Abduction
pose_description: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line, legs stacked, and your head resting on your lower arm. Keep your core engaged and your pelvis stable throughout the movement.
end_pose_description: Lift your top leg toward the ceiling to about 45 degrees, keeping your torso still and avoiding rolling backward. Lower the leg with control without letting it touch the bottom leg.

name: Standing Ankle Eversion with Band
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both forefeet, with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent. Keep your core engaged for stability.
end_pose_description: Turn your feet outward (eversion) against the band resistance, actively engaging the peroneal muscles. Return to neutral position with control.

name: Standing Band Pallof Press
pose_description: Stand perpendicular to an anchor point with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent. Hold a looped band at chest height with both hands, band anchored at chest level beside you.
end_pose_description: Press the band straight out in front of your chest, fully extending your arms while resisting the rotational force. Return to chest height with control, engaging your core throughout.

name: Standing Band Pull-Apart
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Hold a resistance band at eye level with both hands, arms extended straight out in front of you.
end_pose_description: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward in an arc, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Return to the starting position with control, focusing on posterior chain engagement.

name: Standing Band Row
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and the resistance band looped under your feet. Hold both ends of the band with your arms extended straight down in front of you at hip level.
end_pose_description: Pull the band up toward your ribcage by bending your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your elbows should move past your torso with the band handles coming toward your lower chest.

name: Standing Chest Fly with Band
pose_description: Standing with a resistance band anchored behind at chest height, holding one end in each hand. Arms start extended out to the sides at shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbows. The arms sweep forward in an arc, bringing the hands together in front of the chest, squeezing the pectorals. The torso remains upright and stable.
end_pose_description: The person stands upright facing forward with both arms bent at approximately 90 degrees, crossed in front of the chest with hands meeting near the centerline, elbows slightly lower than shoulder height. The chest muscles appear fully contracted and engaged, with the shoulders drawn slightly forward and the upper back rounded inward from the pectoral squeeze. The torso remains stable and vertical with no rotation.

name: Standing Dumbbell Reverse Fly
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides with a slight bend in your elbows and knees. Hinge slightly at the hips while maintaining a neutral spine.
end_pose_description: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top. Lower the dumbbells back down in a controlled motion.

name: Standing Hip Adduction with Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side, with feet hip-width apart. Hold onto a stable surface with your other hand for balance.
end_pose_description: Slowly bring the weighted leg across your body, adducting at the hip toward the midline. Control the weight as you return to the starting position.

name: Standing Hip Internal Rotation
pose_description: Stand upright on one leg with knee bent to 90 degrees, holding onto a support for balance. Keep your standing leg slightly bent and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Rotate your lifted leg outward at the hip, moving your foot away from your body in a semicircular motion. Return to center in a controlled manner and repeat.

name: Standing Rotation with Band
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a resistance band secured at chest height in front of you, holding both ends with arms extended. Keep your hips still and facing forward throughout the exercise.
end_pose_description: Rotate your torso and arms to one side against the band resistance, keeping your core engaged and lower back stable. Return to center with control and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Standing Row with Band
pose_description: Stand facing a resistance band anchored directly in front of you at chest height. Grip the band handles with both hands, arms fully extended forward at shoulder height, feeling tension in the band. Maintain a tall, upright posture with feet parallel or staggered for stability.
end_pose_description: The person stands upright facing forward with elbows bent at approximately 90 degrees, pulled tight against the ribcage with hands drawn back toward the lower chest/upper abdomen. The shoulder blades are visibly retracted and squeezed together, creating prominent definition across the upper back and rear shoulders, while the chest is slightly puffed forward. The resistance band is maximally stretched with tension visible in the biceps and upper back musculature.

name: Supine Gentle Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Bring one arm across your chest towards the opposite shoulder, with the elbow bent. Use your other hand to gently hold the elbow of the arm being stretched.
end_pose_description: Using your unaffected hand, gently pull your affected arm across your body toward the opposite side, creating a mild stretch in the posterior shoulder. Hold this comfortable stretch for 20-30 seconds without forcing beyond a gentle sensation.

name: Supine External Rotation with Bent Elbow
pose_description: Lie on your back with your affected shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees, so your forearm points toward the ceiling. Keep your elbow in contact with the floor throughout the movement.
end_pose_description: Slowly rotate your forearm toward the floor in an external rotation movement, moving only as far as comfort allows without forcing the range. Hold for 1-2 seconds at the end range, then return to the starting position.

name: Supine External Rotation with Dumbbell
pose_description: Lie on your back with your affected shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees. Hold a light dumbbell in your hand with your forearm perpendicular to your body.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm upward toward the floor above your head, moving only at the shoulder's external rotators. Keep your elbow fixed at 90 degrees and stop at a comfortable range without pain.

name: Supine Hip External Rotation
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, roughly hip-width apart. Your arms should rest comfortably at your sides, palms facing down.
end_pose_description: The person lies flat on their back with the left knee bent approximately 90 degrees and dropped maximally outward toward the floor, with the left foot remaining planted and the lower leg externally rotated, while the right leg stays stationary with knee bent and foot flat. The pelvis remains level and neutral, the torso stays flat against the ground, and the glutes and hip external rotators of the working leg appear engaged and stretched at end-range.

name: Supine Hip Internal Rotation
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned wider than hip-width apart.
end_pose_description: The person lies supine with their right knee dropped maximally inward toward the left side of their body, creating an acute angle at the hip while the right foot remains planted on the floor, and the left leg stays stationary with knee bent at approximately 90 degrees. The pelvis remains level against the floor, the torso stays flat and centered, and the internal rotators of the right hip appear engaged and stretched as the knee points toward the midline.

name: Supine Hip Internal/External Rotation
pose_description: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor, keeping the other leg straight and relaxed. Rest your arms at your sides.
end_pose_description: Gently rotate the bent knee inward and outward through a comfortable range of motion, allowing the hip to rotate naturally. Move slowly and stop before any pain or significant resistance.

name: Supine Lower Trunk Rotation
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Keep your arms at your sides for balance and stability.
end_pose_description: Gently lower both knees to one side, allowing controlled rotation of your lower spine and pelvis. Keep your shoulders flat on the floor and return to center before rotating the other direction.

name: Supine Shoulder Flexion with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, holding a resistance band with both hands at your chest level. Your arms are bent at 90 degrees with the band taut.
