end_pose_description: Slowly extend your arms overhead in a controlled manner, keeping the band under tension throughout the movement. Your arms are extended above your chest at the end, moving only as far as comfort allows.

name: Supine Shoulder Flexion with Light Dumbbell
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a light dumbbell (2-3 lbs) in your affected hand with your arm at your side, elbow slightly bent.
end_pose_description: Slowly raise the dumbbell overhead in a controlled arc, moving only at the shoulder joint. Stop at a comfortable range that does not cause pain, typically around 90 degrees of shoulder flexion.

name: Supine Thoracic Rotation
pose_description: Lie on your back with your knees bent and dropped to one side, keeping both shoulders pressed into the floor. Extend both arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, palms facing up.
end_pose_description: Drop both knees to one side while keeping your shoulders flat on the floor and upper back engaged. Feel the stretch along your thoracic spine.

name: Tennis Ball Roll
pose_description: Seated in a chair with one foot resting on a tennis ball placed on the floor. Gentle downward pressure is applied through the foot as it rolls the ball from the toes to the heel and across the arch, massaging the plantar fascia. The opposite foot remains flat on the floor, and the body weight shifts slightly to increase or decrease pressure.
end_pose_description: The seated figure has their working foot rolled back toward the heel with the tennis ball positioned under the arch, knee bent at approximately 90 degrees while the opposite leg remains extended with foot flat on the floor. The torso remains upright and centered in the chair, with visible engagement through the calf and foot musculature as body weight presses downward through the rolling foot, creating tension across the plantar fascia and arch area.

name: Thoracic Spine Rotation - Seated
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and arms crossed over chest with hands behind head. Keep your hips and lower back still against the chair.
end_pose_description: Rotate your upper torso to one side, feeling a stretch across the mid-back and ribcage. Hold the rotation while maintaining an upright posture.

name: Thoracic Rotation Stretch
pose_description: Start on hands and knees with neutral spine and shoulders over wrists. Place one hand behind your head with elbow pointing out.
end_pose_description: Rotate your thoracic spine, bringing your elbow toward the opposite knee while following with your gaze. Feel the stretch across your upper back and shoulders.

name: Thread the Needle
pose_description: On hands and knees in tabletop position. One arm threads underneath the body, reaching through the space between the opposite arm and knee, with the shoulder and temple resting on the floor. The hips remain over the knees, and the supporting arm may stay straight or bend slightly. A deep rotation stretch is felt through the thoracic spine and shoulder.
end_pose_description: The body is in a deep spinal rotation with the right shoulder and right temple pressed flat against the floor, the right arm fully threaded underneath the torso with the palm facing up, while the left arm remains straight and supporting the upper body weight. The hips stay squared over the knees in a kneeling position, and the head is turned to face downward toward the floor with the spine twisted maximally through the thoracic region, creating visible tension through the shoulder blade, obliques, and upper back muscles.

name: Thumb Abduction with Band Resistance
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down with fingers relaxed. A resistance band is looped around your thumb and index finger.
end_pose_description: Pull your thumb away from your index finger against the band resistance, creating a 45-degree angle. Hold this position briefly before returning to start.

name: Toe Curls with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the ground and a light resistance band looped around all five toes. Your foot is relaxed with toes extended.
end_pose_description: Curl all your toes downward against the resistance of the band, engaging the intrinsic foot muscles. Hold briefly before returning to the extended position.

name: Wall Squat with Ball
pose_description: Standing with an exercise ball or stability ball placed between the mid-back and a wall. Feet are shoulder-width apart, positioned about two feet in front of the body. The body lowers into a squat by bending the knees to approximately 90 degrees while the ball rolls along the wall. The back stays pressed into the ball and the knees track over the toes.
end_pose_description: The person is in a deep squat position with knees bent at approximately 90 degrees, thighs nearly parallel to the ground, while their back remains firmly pressed against the stability ball that has rolled down the wall. Their torso is upright and stable, feet are planted shoulder-width apart pointing forward, and their quadriceps, glutes, and core muscles are visibly tensed and engaged. The person faces directly forward with a neutral head position.

name: Radial/Ulnar Deviation with Band
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down with your hand extended beyond the edge. A resistance band is wrapped around your hand.
end_pose_description: Move your hand sideways toward your thumb (radial deviation) against light band resistance, then return. Repeat the movement in the opposite direction slowly and controlled.

name: Wrist Extension with Band
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing downward with your hand hanging slightly off the edge. A resistance band is wrapped around your hand.
end_pose_description: Extend your wrist upward against the band resistance, lifting your hand toward the ceiling. Pause at the top before slowly lowering back to the starting position.

name: Wrist Extension with Dumbbell
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table or your thigh, palm facing downward, holding a light dumbbell. Your wrist hangs slightly beyond the edge of the support surface.
end_pose_description: Slowly lift your hand upward by extending your wrist, raising the dumbbell toward the ceiling. Hold briefly at the top before lowering in a controlled manner.

name: Knee Extension with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit on a bench or chair with a resistance band looped around your foot and held in your hands. Keep your back against the support with your leg slightly bent.
end_pose_description: Sit on the bench or chair with the resistance band still looped around your foot and held in your hands, your back against the support. Your leg is extended straight out in front of you, with your knee fully straightened and the quadriceps visibly contracted, while the hamstrings are stretched.

name: Hamstring Curls with Resistance Band
pose_description: Stand upright and loop a resistance band around both feet while holding the band ends for stability. Keep a slight bend in both knees.
end_pose_description: The body remains upright, with the standing leg maintaining its slight knee bend. The working leg is flexed at the knee, drawing the heel fully towards the glute, which keeps the resistance band taut and visibly engages the hamstrings and glutes.

name: Clamshells with Resistance Band
pose_description: Lie on your side with both knees bent at 45 degrees and a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Keep your feet together.
end_pose_description: Lie on your side with the bottom knee bent at 45 degrees and the top knee elevated as far as possible, with the resistance band above the knees taut. The feet remain together, and the gluteus medius and minimus of the top leg are visibly engaged.

name: Lateral Band Walks with Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell at chest height with both hands, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent. Maintain an upright torso throughout the movement.
end_pose_description: Both feet are wider than hip-width apart, with knees deeply bent as the torso remains upright and the dumbbell is held at chest height. The gluteus medius and maximus are visibly contracted, alongside engagement of the quadriceps and a stretch in the inner thighs.

name: Monster Walks with Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand holding a dumbbell at chest height with feet hip-width apart and knees bent slightly in a quarter-squat position. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Stand holding a dumbbell at chest height with one foot abducted laterally, now positioned approximately two times hip-width from the stationary foot. Both knees remain slightly bent in a quarter-squat, and your chest is upright with your core engaged. The gluteus medius and minimus of the abducted hip are visibly contracted.

name: Standing Hip Abduction with Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine.
end_pose_description: One leg is lifted directly out to the side, knee straight and foot flexed, reaching its peak height without tilting the torso. The dumbbell remains at your side in the hand corresponding to the lifted leg. Maintain an upright posture with your core engaged and spine neutral. The gluteus medius and minimus are visibly contracted on the abducted leg, while the opposing hip adductors are lengthened.

name: Clamshells with Band
pose_description: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent to 45 degrees and a resistance band looped around your thighs. Keep your feet together and your core engaged.
end_pose_description: The body remains on its side with the bottom hip and knee maintaining a 45-degree bend. The top knee is rotated upward, away from the bottom knee, while the feet remain pressed together. The taut resistance band highlights activation of the gluteus medius and other external hip rotators.

name: Step-Ups with Band
pose_description: Stand facing a low step or bench with a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Maintain upright posture and engage your core.
end_pose_description: One foot is planted completely flat on the step, and the opposite foot hovers just off the ground directly behind it. The torso is fully erect and aligned over the elevated leg, with the resistance band still around the thighs above the knees. The glutes and quadriceps of the elevated leg are powerfully engaged, maintaining this stable, upright position.

name: Scapular Squeezes with Dumbbell
pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and hold a light dumbbell in each hand at chest height with elbows bent. Your shoulders should be relaxed and in a neutral position.
end_pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and hold a light dumbbell in each hand at chest height with elbows bent. Your shoulder blades are retracted and depressed, pulling your shoulders back and widening your chest. The rhomboids and middle trapezius are visibly contracted.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides. Bring your affected arm across your body at shoulder height with the elbow slightly bent.
end_pose_description: Maintain an upright posture with feet shoulder-width apart. The affected arm is fully extended across the chest at shoulder height, with its elbow slightly bent, while the unaffected hand or forearm is positioned behind the affected elbow, applying gentle pressure to deepen the stretch and visibly elongate the posterior deltoid and rotator cuff muscles of the affected shoulder.

name: Band Pull-Apart
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended straight out in front of you at shoulder height. Hold the resistance band with both hands, keeping your arms parallel to the ground with a slight bend in your elbows.
end_pose_description: Maintain an upright standing position with feet shoulder-width apart, your arms extended straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground, and at shoulder height, maintaining a slight bend in your elbows. The resistance band is stretched taut across your chest, with your shoulder blades retracted and pectorals stretched, while the rhomboids, rear deltoids, and middle trapezius are visibly engaged.

name: Prone I-Y-T Raises with Band
pose_description: Lie face down on a bench or table with your chest off the edge and your arms hanging down. Hold the resistance band in both hands with your arms at your sides.
end_pose_description: Your arms are extended straight forward and overhead, aligned with your body, forming an 'I' shape, with the resistance band held taut in your hands. Your arms are elevated as high as possible, visibly engaging the posterior deltoids, rhomboids, and lower trapezius, while the pectorals are in a lengthened position.

name: Supine Marching with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. A resistance band is looped around both feet, and your hands are behind your head for light neck support.
end_pose_description: One leg remains with the knee bent and foot flat on the floor, while the other leg is lifted so the knee is bent at 90 degrees and positioned directly above the hip. The resistance band is taut, pulling on the lifted foot, and your hands remain behind your head for light neck support. The abdominal muscles are visibly engaged to stabilize the core, with contraction visible in the hip flexors on the lifted side.

name: Child's Pose with Rotation
pose_description: Begin on hands and knees, then sink your hips back to your heels with arms extended forward on the floor. Rest your forehead toward the ground.
end_pose_description: Hips remain settled back towards the heels. One arm is extended beneath the other, reaching across the body with the palm facing upward; the shoulder of this arm and the corresponding side of the head rest on the floor. The spine displays a visible rotation, with a deep stretch evident through the mid-back and obliques.

name: Side Plank with Hip Drop
pose_description: Lie on your side propped up on your forearm, with legs stacked and your body forming a straight line from head to feet. Engage your core and keep your hips lifted off the ground.
end_pose_description: Lie on your side propped up on your forearm, with legs stacked. Your body forms a gentle curve at the waist, and your hips are positioned just above the ground. The obliques on your underside are visibly stretched, while your top-side core muscles are engaged to stabilize the trunk.

name: Lateral Band Walk
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart with a resistance band looped just below your knees, maintaining a quarter-squat position with knees bent. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Maintain the quarter-squat position with knees bent, chest up, and core engaged. One foot remains under its respective hip, while the other foot is positioned laterally wide, creating significant tension in the resistance band just below the knees. The glutes and outer hip muscles of both legs are visibly engaged to hold this wide stance against the band's resistance.

name: Clamshells with Resistance Band
pose_description: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent at 45 degrees, with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Keep your feet together and aligned.
end_pose_description: Lie on your side with hips still stacked and the bottom knee bent at 45 degrees. The top knee is elevated and abducted away from the bottom knee, creating a wide opening between the thighs, with the resistance band taut and stretched. Your feet remain together and aligned, and the gluteal muscles of the top hip are visibly contracted.

name: Standing Hip Abduction with Band
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees, feet hip-width apart. Maintain a slight bend in both knees with good posture.
end_pose_description: The body remains upright, with the standing leg maintaining a slight bend in the knee and the foot grounded. The other leg is extended out to the side, away from the midline, with the foot elevated slightly off the floor. The resistance band is taut between the legs. The gluteus medius and minimus muscles of the abducted leg are visibly engaged, and the adductor muscles of that leg are stretched.

name: Standing Hip Abduction with Band
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Keep your feet together and hands on your hips for balance.
end_pose_description: One leg remains planted firmly on the ground, while the other leg is extended straight out to the side, away from the body, maintaining an upright torso. The resistance band is significantly taut between the legs. The gluteus medius and minimus on the extended leg are actively engaged, while the inner thigh muscles of that same leg are visibly stretched.

name: Grip Strengthening with Soft Ball
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected arm resting on your lap or table, holding a soft foam ball or stress ball in your hand. Your fingers should be relaxed around the ball.
end_pose_description: Your affected arm is resting on your lap or table, with your fingers and thumb firmly closed around the soft ball. The ball is compressed by your grip, and the intrinsic muscles of your hand and the flexors in your forearm are visibly engaged.

name: Grip Strengthening with Therapy Ball
pose_description: Sit upright with a soft therapy ball in your right hand, arm resting on your lap. Your hand should be in a relaxed, neutral position.
end_pose_description: Sit upright with a soft therapy ball compressed within your right hand, arm resting on your lap. Your fingers and thumb are tightly curled around the ball, forming a strong grip. The flexor muscles along the front of your forearm are visibly taut.

name: Grip Strengthening with Band
pose_description: Sit upright with your arm resting at your side, holding a resistance band looped in your hand with fingers relaxed around it. Your palm faces inward.
end_pose_description: Sit upright with your arm resting at your side, holding the resistance band tightly compressed within your fully closed fist. Your palm still faces inward, and the muscles of your forearm and hand are visibly contracted.

name: Wrist Pronation/Supination with Dumbbell
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table or your leg, holding a light dumbbell vertically with your affected arm. Your elbow remains bent at 90 degrees and stationary throughout.
end_pose_description: Your forearm remains resting on the table or your leg, and your elbow is still bent at 90 degrees. The dumbbell is now horizontal, with the palm of your affected hand facing upwards, demonstrating full supination. The supinator and biceps brachii muscles are visibly engaged.

name: Supine Elbow Extension with Light Dumbbell
pose_description: Lie on your back with your affected elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding a light dumbbell. Your upper arm is perpendicular to your body, and your forearm points toward the ceiling.
end_pose_description: Lie on your back with your affected elbow fully extended, holding a light dumbbell directly above your shoulder. Your upper arm is perpendicular to your body, and your forearm points straight toward the ceiling. The triceps brachii is engaged, and the biceps brachii is stretched.

name: Bicep Curls with Light Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in your affected hand with your arm extended at your side. Your palm faces forward and your elbow stays close to your body.
end_pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in your affected hand with your arm fully flexed at the elbow. The dumbbell is positioned near your shoulder, your palm faces forward, and your elbow remains close to your body. The biceps brachii is visibly contracted.

name: Grip Strengthening with Tennis Ball
pose_description: Sit upright holding a soft tennis ball in your affected hand with your arm resting on your lap. Your fingers are relaxed around the ball.
end_pose_description: Sit upright, holding the soft tennis ball tightly in your affected hand with your arm resting on your lap. Your fingers are fully contracted around the ball, which is visibly compressed, and the forearm flexors and intrinsic hand muscles are engaged.

name: Finger Extension with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table and a resistance band looped around all your fingers. Your fingers are in a slightly flexed position.
end_pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on the table, the resistance band still looped around all your fingers. Your fingers are fully straightened, held against the resistance of the band, and the extensor muscles along the back of your forearm are visibly engaged.

name: Wrist Circles with Light Weight
pose_description: Stand upright with your arm extended out to the side at shoulder height, holding a light weight in your hand. Your wrist is in neutral position.
end_pose_description: Stand upright with your arm still extended out to the side at shoulder height, holding a light weight in your hand. Your wrist is fully bent downwards, with the palm facing the ground. The forearm flexor muscles are engaged, and the forearm extensor muscles are stretched.

name: Wrist Flexion with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Loop a resistance band around your hand just below the fingers.
end_pose_description: The hand is flexed at the wrist, angled downward towards the forearm, with the palm still facing generally upward. The resistance band is taut, pulling against the hand. The wrist flexors on the anterior forearm are visibly engaged, and the wrist extensors on the posterior forearm are in a stretched position.

name: Wrist Radial Deviation with Band
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand in neutral position holding one end of a resistance band. The band is anchored on the ulnar side.
end_pose_description: Your forearm remains resting on the table. The hand is maximally deviated towards the thumb side, with the wrist angled upwards and outwards against the resistance band. The extensors and flexors on the radial side of the forearm are visibly engaged, and the ulnar side of the wrist experiences a stretch.

name: Pronation/Supination with Band
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding a resistance band attached to a fixed point. Your palm starts facing down.
end_pose_description: You remain seated with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, your forearm fully rotated so your palm faces directly upwards. The resistance band is still held in your hand. The supinator and biceps brachii muscles are visibly engaged, while the pronator teres muscle is stretched.

name: Finger Extension with Resistance Band Alternative
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand in a relaxed fist position. Your opposite hand is positioned to gently assist.
end_pose_description: The hand is open with fingers and thumb fully extended and straightened, the palm facing towards the table. The extensor muscles on the top of the forearm are visibly contracted, and the flexor muscles on the underside of the forearm and hand are stretched. The assisting opposite hand maintains its position, gently supporting the hand in this fully extended posture.

name: Light Dumbbell Bicep Curl
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides and palms facing forward. Keep your elbows close to your body and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand with forearms fully bent and dumbbells near your shoulders, palms facing forward. Your elbows remain close to your body, core engaged, and biceps brachii visibly contracted.

name: Tricep Extension with Dumbbell
pose_description: Sit upright holding a light dumbbell with both hands, raising it overhead with elbows bent at approximately 90 degrees. Your elbows should stay close to your head and relatively stationary.
end_pose_description: Sit upright, holding the dumbbell overhead with both hands. Both arms are fully extended straight up towards the ceiling, with the elbows completely straightened and still close to your head. The triceps are visibly engaged.

name: Wrist Flexion with Dumbbell
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, palm facing up, holding a light dumbbell in your hand with your wrist in a neutral position. Keep your forearm stable and in contact with your leg.
end_pose_description: Sit with your forearm still resting on your thigh, palm facing up, holding the light dumbbell, your wrist fully flexed so the dumbbell is positioned as close as possible to your forearm. The muscles on the underside of your forearm are visibly contracted, while the muscles on the top of your forearm are elongated.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells in each hand with arms at your sides and palms facing your thighs (neutral grip). Keep your elbows stationary close to your body.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells in each hand. Your forearms are vertical, and the dumbbells are positioned close to your shoulders, with palms still facing each other. Elbows remain stationary and tucked close to the body. The biceps and brachioradialis muscles are visibly contracted, and the triceps are stretched.

name: Prone Knee Flexion with Band
pose_description: Lie face down on the floor with a resistance band looped around your foot. Your arms are folded under your forehead for support.
end_pose_description: Lie face down on the floor, with your arms folded under your forehead, and one leg straight. The other knee is maximally bent, bringing that foot's heel as close as possible to the glutes. The resistance band around the working foot is taut, highlighting strongly contracted hamstrings and visibly stretched quadriceps.

name: Supine Hip Abduction with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. A resistance band is looped around both knees.
end_pose_description: The person lies on their back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. The resistance band is taut and stretched, holding both knees as far apart as possible. The outer hip and gluteal muscles are visibly contracted, while the inner thigh muscles appear stretched.

name: Dumbbell Deadlifts (Light)
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms straight. Keep your chest up and shoulders back.
end_pose_description: Torso is hinged forward at the hips, nearly parallel to the floor, with a slight bend in the knees. The dumbbells hang straight down, near the shins, while the back remains flat and straight. Hamstrings and glutes are visibly stretched, and the lower back muscles are engaged to maintain spinal alignment.

name: Supine Hip Abduction with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a resistance band around both thighs just above the knees.
end_pose_description: The individual is on their back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, now significantly wider than hip-width apart. The knees are widely separated, pushing outward against the taut resistance band around the thighs. The gluteus medius and minimus are visibly contracted.

name: Standing Hip Flexion with Band
pose_description: Stand upright facing a stable surface for light support, with a resistance band looped around one foot. Keep your standing leg straight with a slight knee bend for stability.
end_pose_description: Maintain an upright posture, still facing the stable surface, with the resistance band looped around one foot. The banded leg is positioned with the thigh roughly parallel to the floor and the knee bent at approximately 90 degrees. The standing leg remains straight with a slight knee bend for stability, and the hip flexors of the raised leg are visibly engaged.

name: Supine Hip Internal/External Rotation
pose_description: Lie on your back with one hip and knee bent to 90 degrees, with a light resistance band around the thigh. Keep your lower back neutral and engaged.
end_pose_description: The bent hip is fully externally rotated, with the knee remaining at 90 degrees. The lower leg and foot are positioned laterally away from the body's midline, reaching the maximum comfortable range. The gluteal muscles and deep hip rotators are engaged, and the hip adductors and internal rotators are stretched, with the lower back still neutral and engaged.

name: Supine Hip Adduction with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. Place a resistance band around both thighs above the knees.
end_pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Both knees are pressed firmly together, actively squeezing against the resistance band. The inner thigh and adductor muscles are visibly engaged and contracted.

name: Sidelying Hip Abduction with Band
pose_description: Lie on your side with legs extended and stacked, with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Keep your core engaged and head resting on your arm.
end_pose_description: The bottom leg remains extended and rested on the floor, while the top leg is extended and elevated directly upwards, away from the bottom leg, as far as possible without tilting the torso. The resistance band above the knees is taut, and the gluteus medius on the top leg is visibly engaged. The core is engaged, and the head rests on the arm.

name: Standing Hip Extension with Band
pose_description: Stand facing a stable surface with a resistance band looped around one foot, keeping your posture upright. Engage your core and hold the support surface lightly.
end_pose_description: The banded leg is extended directly backward, with the foot elevated slightly behind the body. The supporting leg remains straight, and the torso stays upright with the core engaged, maintaining a light hold on the support surface. The glutes and hamstrings of the extended leg are contracted, with the hip flexors on that same side elongated.

name: Figure-4 Stretch with Band Assist
pose_description: Lie on your back with one knee bent and crossed over the opposite thigh in a figure-4 position. Place a band around the thigh of the bottom leg for gentle assistance.
end_pose_description: The bottom knee is positioned close to the chest, with the band taut around its thigh. The hands grasp the band, maintaining a significant stretch through the outer hip and gluteal muscles of the crossed leg.

name: Lying Affected Side Rotation with Pillow
pose_description: Lie on your unaffected side with hips and knees slightly bent for stability, and place a pillow between your knees. Your affected arm is bent at the elbow and rests on your torso.
end_pose_description: Your unaffected side remains stable, with hips and knees bent and the pillow still secured between them. Your affected elbow stays bent at 90 degrees, fixed against your torso, while your forearm is externally rotated until the back of your hand points towards the surface behind your head. The posterior rotator cuff muscles are engaged, and the anterior shoulder muscles are visibly stretched.

name: Scapular Squeeze with Dumbbells
pose_description: Stand upright holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms extended and palms facing inward. Keep your neck in a neutral position with minimal movement.
end_pose_description: The shoulders are pulled back, with the shoulder blades maximally squeezed towards the spine, causing the chest to visibly expand. Dumbbells remain at your sides with arms extended, palms facing inward, and positioned slightly further back, while the rhomboids and middle trapezius muscles of the upper back are visibly contracted and the neck remains neutral.

name: Supine Dumbbell Chest Press
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat, and dumbbells held at chest level with elbows at 90 degrees. Ensure your head and neck remain supported and neutral.
end_pose_description: Maintain your back on the mat, knees bent, and feet flat, with dumbbells held directly above the center of the chest and arms fully extended upwards, ensuring a very slight bend at the elbows. The chest muscles (pectorals) are visibly contracted, and your head and neck remain supported and neutral.

name: Supination and Pronation
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, tucked against your side, holding a light weight or object in your hand. Start with your palm facing down.
end_pose_description: Your elbow remains bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your side, holding the light weight or object in your hand. Your palm is facing directly upward. The supinator and biceps brachii muscles are visibly engaged in the forearm and upper arm, while the pronator muscles are stretched.

name: Seated Ankle Plantarflexion with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your legs extended in front of you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot with your heel resting on the ground.
end_pose_description: Your foot is pointed downwards, pressing the ball of your foot into the resistance band. Your heel remains resting on the ground, with your calf muscles visibly contracted. The muscles on the front of your shin are in a lengthened position.

name: Supine Ankle Dorsiflexion with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with legs extended and a resistance band looped around the ball of your foot. Keep your heel on the surface with your foot in a neutral position.
end_pose_description: Your legs remain extended with the heel still on the surface. The top of your foot is positioned as close to your shin as possible, with the toes pointing upwards towards your head. The tibialis anterior muscle on the front of your shin is taut, and the calf muscles are stretched.

name: Standing Quad Sets with Band
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your knee and the other end anchored low behind you. Keep your knee slightly bent and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Stand upright with your knee fully extended, holding the resistance band taut and stretched behind it. Your quadriceps are intensely contracted and visibly tensed, maintaining the forward position of the knee against the band's pull. Your core remains engaged.

name: Prone Hip Extension with Band
pose_description: Lie face down on a comfortable surface with a resistance band looped around both feet. Rest your forehead on your arms to maintain neutral spine alignment.
end_pose_description: Your legs are straight and slightly elevated a few inches off the surface, with the resistance band under tension around your feet. Your gluteal muscles are visibly contracted, indicating hip extension, while your forehead remains resting on your arms with a neutral spine alignment.

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch with Band
pose_description: Sit upright with one leg extended in front of you and the other knee bent with foot on the floor. Place a resistance band around the ball of your extended foot, holding both ends.
end_pose_description: Your torso is leaned forward from the hips, positioned closely to the extended leg while maintaining a straight back. Your hands hold the resistance band taut, creating visible tension as the hamstring of the extended leg is stretched.

name: Quadruped Leg Lift
pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
end_pose_description: One knee remains under its hip, with the hands under the shoulders. The other leg is elevated behind the body, its knee bent at 90 degrees, and the sole of the foot facing the ceiling. The thigh of the lifted leg is parallel to the floor, and the spine remains neutral with the core engaged, visibly contracting the hamstrings and gluteus maximus.

name: Lateral Band Walks with Dumbbells
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, knees slightly bent in a quarter-squat position. Your chest is up and core is engaged.
end_pose_description: Your leading foot is stepped out to the side, creating a stance significantly wider than shoulder-width, with both knees maintaining the quarter-squat bend. Dumbbells are still held at your sides, chest up, and core engaged. The gluteus medius and minimus of both hips are actively engaged, and a slight stretch is present in the adductors of the trailing leg.

name: Resistance Band Internal Rotation
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side, holding a resistance band with both hands. Keep your upper arm stationary against your ribcage throughout the movement.
end_pose_description: The body remains upright with feet shoulder-width apart, with the active arm's upper arm pressed against the ribcage and elbow bent at 90 degrees. Its forearm is internally rotated, with the hand holding one end of the resistance band positioned across the front of the body towards the navel, while the other hand firmly holds the opposite end of the band, held taut. The subscapularis and pectoralis major muscles are visibly engaged, and the posterior deltoid and infraspinatus are stretched.

name: Resistance Band Horizontal Abduction
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended in front of you at shoulder height, holding a resistance band stretched between your hands. Maintain a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, with your arms extended out to your sides at shoulder height, holding the resistance band maximally stretched between your hands. A slight bend is maintained in your elbows. The posterior deltoids and rhomboids are visibly contracted, while the chest muscles are stretched.

name: Resistance Band Row
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart on a resistance band, holding the ends with both hands and arms extended downward in front of you. Maintain a neutral spine and slight knee bend throughout the movement.
end_pose_description: Standing with feet shoulder-width apart on the resistance band, both hands are pulled back to the sides of your torso, near your hips. Your elbows are bent sharply and pointing directly backward, with your shoulder blades strongly retracted and squeezed together. The latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, trapezius, and biceps are visibly contracted, creating definition in your upper back and arms.

name: Resistance Band Shoulder Flexion
pose_description: Stand on a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the ends at your sides with arms extended downward. Maintain good posture with shoulders relaxed.
end_pose_description: Your body maintains good posture with feet shoulder-width apart on the resistance band. Your arms are extended straight forward and slightly upward, reaching approximately eye level, with hands still holding the band ends and the anterior deltoids visibly engaged.

name: Resistance Band Lateral Raise
pose_description: Stand on a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the ends at your sides with arms extended downward and a slight elbow bend. Keep your core engaged and posture upright.
end_pose_description: Core is engaged and posture is upright. Your arms are extended horizontally out to the sides, with a slight elbow bend, forming a "T" shape with your torso, and your hands holding the band ends are level with your shoulders. The deltoid muscles are visibly contracted and the upper trapezius may also be engaged.

name: Supine Shoulder External Rotation
pose_description: Lie on your back with your affected shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees, palm facing your head. Keep your upper arm perpendicular to your body.
end_pose_description: Your affected shoulder is abducted to 90 degrees and your elbow is bent to 90 degrees, with your upper arm perpendicular to your body. Your forearm is externally rotated, pointing downwards towards your feet, and your palm faces your feet; the posterior rotator cuff muscles are visibly engaged, and the anterior shoulder muscles are stretched.

name: Glute Bridge with Dumbbell
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a dumbbell resting across your hips. Your arms should be at your sides with palms down for stability.
end_pose_description: Your hips are maximally elevated towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders through your hips to your knees, with the dumbbell still resting across your hips at this highest point. Your glutes and hamstrings are strongly contracted, and your feet remain flat on the floor, hip-width apart, with your arms at your sides for stability.

name: Dumbbell Row
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms extended. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine with a slight forward hinge at the hips.
end_pose_description: Maintain the slight forward hip hinge and neutral spine, with your core engaged. The dumbbells are held close to your sides, near the lower ribcage, with elbows bent and pulled back beyond the plane of the torso. Your shoulder blades are visibly retracted and depressed, indicating strong engagement of the latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, and biceps.

name: Pallof Press with Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell at chest height with both hands, perpendicular to your torso. Keep your core tight and shoulders squared forward.
end_pose_description: With feet shoulder-width apart, the dumbbell is now held straight out in front of the body at chest height, arms fully extended. The torso and shoulders remain squared forward, resisting any rotational pull. The deep core muscles, especially the obliques and transversus abdominis, are maximally engaged and braced to maintain this stable position.

name: Quadruped Hip Circle
pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with a neutral spine, wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Lift one knee slightly off the ground.
end_pose_description: Maintain a neutral spine with wrists under shoulders. The lifted knee is positioned high and wide, with the working thigh nearly parallel to the floor and the hip maximally abducted and externally rotated. The gluteus medius and maximus are visibly contracted, while the hip adductors and internal rotators are stretched.

name: Seated Ankle Plantarflexion with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg extended in front of you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding the ends in your hands.
end_pose_description: Your injured leg remains extended in front of you, with your body upright in the chair. Your foot is pointed downwards, away from your shin, against the taut resistance band. The calf muscles (gastrocnemius and soleus) are visibly contracted, and the muscles on the front of your shin are elongated.

name: Lateral Ankle Inversion with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg extended or bent at the knee. Loop a resistance band around the forefoot and hold the ends with your hands.
end_pose_description: The injured foot is rotated inwards at the ankle, with the sole facing the midline of the body, and the resistance band is taut. The tibialis anterior and tibialis posterior muscles on the inner shin are visibly engaged, while the peroneal muscles on the outer ankle are stretched.

name: Lateral Ankle Eversion with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your injured leg extended or bent at the knee. Loop a resistance band around the forefoot and hold the ends with your hands.
end_pose_description: The injured foot is positioned so its sole faces outwards and slightly upwards, creating tension in the resistance band looped around the forefoot. The outer ankle muscles, specifically the peroneus longus and brevis, are visibly contracted and shortened on the lateral side of the lower leg.

name: Resistance Band Adduction
pose_description: Lie on your unaffected side with both legs extended and a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Keep your torso stable and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Lie on your unaffected side with both legs extended, the resistance band taut and the top leg firmly pressed against the bottom leg. Both legs touch along their entire length, and the inner thigh muscles of the top leg are visibly contracted. Your torso remains stable with your core engaged.

name: Prone Hip Internal Rotation Stretch
pose_description: Lie face-down on the floor with your forearms supporting your upper body. Bend one knee and bring that foot toward the opposite side of your body.
end_pose_description: Lie face-down on the floor with your forearms supporting your upper body. The bent knee remains grounded, and that foot is positioned fully across the opposite side of your body, with the lower leg resting on the floor. The hip external rotators and groin muscles of the bent leg are maximally stretched.

name: Step-Ups with Dumbbells
pose_description: Stand facing a step or low platform (12-18 inches) holding dumbbells at your sides with arms extended. Plant your foot firmly on the step with your whole foot making contact.
end_pose_description: Stand fully upright on the step, with your lead foot firmly planted and its leg fully extended. The trailing leg is positioned onto the step, with its foot lightly touching or hovering just above the platform. The quadriceps and glutes of the lead leg are visibly contracted, while the hip flexors of the trailing leg are engaged. Dumbbells remain at your sides with arms extended.

name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunges
pose_description: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides with feet hip-width apart and your weight evenly distributed. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture throughout the movement.
end_pose_description: One leg is stepped diagonally back and across behind the other, with both knees deeply bent. The front thigh is nearly parallel to the floor and the front knee is aligned over the ankle, while the back knee is lowered close to the ground behind the front foot. The torso remains upright, and dumbbells are held at the sides. The gluteus maximus, quadriceps, and hamstrings of the front leg are visibly engaged, and the hip flexors of the back leg are stretched.

name: Resistance Band Rows
pose_description: Sit upright with feet flat on the floor and loop a resistance band around a fixed point at chest height. Hold both ends of the band with arms extended forward at shoulder width.
end_pose_description: Sit upright with feet flat on the floor, the resistance band taut and pulled towards the body. Elbows are bent and pulled back, close to the torso, with hands positioned near the lower rib cage, still holding both ends of the band. The shoulder blades are squeezed together, and the latissimus dorsi and rhomboids are visibly contracted in the upper back.

name: Resistance Band Pull-Aparts
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band with both hands at shoulder height, arms extended in front of you. The band should be taut but not stretched at the starting position.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended out to the sides and slightly behind the torso, holding the fully stretched resistance band. The shoulder blades are visibly retracted, with the rhomboids and rear deltoids engaged, while the chest muscles are stretched.

name: Upper Back Strengthening with Band
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a looped resistance band at waist level with both hands. Your arms should be straight down with a slight bend at the elbows and the band at rest.
end_pose_description: The hands are pulled back towards the sides of your upper abdomen, with elbows sharply bent and tucked close to your body, stretching the resistance band taut. Your shoulder blades are powerfully retracted, visibly engaging the rhomboids, middle trapezius, and posterior deltoids.

name: Posterior Neck Stretch with Band
pose_description: Sit upright and loop a resistance band around the back of your head at about ear level, holding both ends of the band in your hands. Keep your neck in a neutral position.
end_pose_description: Maintain the upright seated position with the resistance band looped around the back of your head, held by your hands. Your head is in full flexion, with your chin resting close to your chest, creating a deep stretch along the posterior neck muscles.

name: Thoracic Extension with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around your upper back at shoulder blade height, holding both ends across your chest. Your shoulders should be relaxed and your spine neutral.
end_pose_description: Your upper back is deeply arched into extension, and your chest is pressed forward against the taut resistance band. Your shoulders are retracted, and your head is aligned with your extended thoracic spine, with a slight upward gaze. The erector spinae and rhomboids are engaged, while the pectoralis muscles across your chest are visibly stretched.

name: Resistance Band Reverse Fly
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bent knees, holding a resistance band with both hands at waist level in front of your body. Your arms should be extended straight with a slight bend at the elbows.
end_pose_description: Your feet remain shoulder-width apart with slightly bent knees. Your arms are extended straight, with a slight bend at the elbows, positioned out to your sides, forming a 'T' shape with your body. The resistance band is stretched taut across your chest, and your shoulder blades are squeezed together, visibly engaging the posterior deltoids, rhomboids, and trapezius, with the pectorals stretched across the front.

name: Thoracic Spine Rotation
pose_description: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Your spine is neutral and core is engaged.
end_pose_description: One hand is positioned behind the head with the elbow pointed directly towards the ceiling. The head is turned, gazing upwards, and the upper body is rotated through the thoracic spine. The supporting arm remains stable with the wrist under the shoulder, while the muscles of the thoracic spine and obliques on the side of the raised elbow are engaged, and the opposite obliques are stretched.

name: Dumbbell Shrugs
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides with arms extended. Your shoulders are relaxed and your chest is up.
end_pose_description: You remain standing upright with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides with arms extended. Your shoulders are elevated high, nearly touching your ears, with the upper trapezius muscles visibly contracted and bulging. Your chest is still up.

name: Band Rows
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band at arm's length in front of you with both hands. Keep your core engaged and maintain a neutral spine.
end_pose_description: Your feet remain shoulder-width apart, core engaged, and spine neutral. Your hands are pulled back towards your torso, with elbows bent and the resistance band taut and close to your body. Your shoulder blades are visibly retracted, highlighting the contracted latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, and trapezius muscles in your back, along with engaged biceps.

name: Seated Thoracic Rotation
pose_description: Sit upright on a chair or bench with feet flat on the floor. Cross your arms across your chest, with your right hand touching your left shoulder and left hand touching your right shoulder.
end_pose_description: The torso is fully rotated to the right, with the shoulders and chest aligned toward the right side. The lower body, including the hips and feet, remains fixed and facing forward, and the arms stay crossed with hands on opposite shoulders. The core muscles, including the obliques and erector spinae on the right, are visibly engaged, while the muscles on the left side of the back and torso are stretched.

name: Thoracic Rotation
pose_description: Begin on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Place one hand behind your head with elbow pointing out to the side.
end_pose_description: The hands and knees remain in their starting position with the hand still behind the head. The elbow from that hand points directly towards the ceiling, indicating maximum thoracic rotation. The spinal rotators and obliques are engaged, while the chest and side muscles on the opposite side appear stretched.

name: Spinal Twist
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms spread out to the sides in a T position. Keep your back flat against the floor.
end_pose_description: The knees are bent and stacked, resting on the floor to the right side, with the feet stacked beneath them. The upper back and shoulders are flat on the floor, arms spread in a T position, while the lower back is lifted from the floor, and the head is turned to the left. The spine and glutes on the left side are stretched, and the right obliques are visibly engaged.

name: Banded Hip Abduction
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Keep your core engaged and hands on your hips for balance.
end_pose_description: Maintain an upright torso with one foot planted firmly on the ground. The other leg is extended directly out to the side, away from the body, stretching the resistance band taut. Your hips remain level, core engaged, and hands on your hips. The gluteus medius and minimus of the extended leg are visibly contracted.

name: Banded Clamshells
pose_description: Lie on your right side with a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees and your knees bent at 45 degrees. Stack your hips and keep your core engaged.
end_pose_description: The left knee is externally rotated and raised significantly away from the right knee, while the heels stay pressed together. The hips remain stacked and still, and the core is engaged. The resistance band is taut, and the gluteus medius and gluteus minimus of the left leg are visibly contracted.

name: Banded Hip Bridge
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Place arms at your sides with palms down.
end_pose_description: Your hips are elevated, creating a straight line from your shoulders through your hips to your knees. Knees remain bent, pushing against the resistance band to keep feet flat and hip-width apart on the floor. Arms are at your sides with palms down, and the glutes and hamstrings are visibly engaged while the hip flexors are stretched.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Slightly bend your knees and keep your torso upright with hands on your hips.
end_pose_description: The feet are positioned wide apart, with one foot laterally separated from the other; the stance is significantly wider than hip-width. Knees are slightly bent, and the torso is upright with hands on hips. The resistance band is taut and stretched across the thighs, with the gluteus medius visibly engaged on the outer hips of both legs.

name: Thoracic Rotation in Quadruped
pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Place your left hand behind your head with elbow pointing out to the side.
end_pose_description: Your right hand remains under your shoulder and knees remain under your hips. Your torso is rotated significantly to the left and upwards, with your left elbow pointing directly towards the ceiling and your head looking upwards, visibly engaging the muscles of your left mid-back and obliques and stretching the muscles of your right mid-back.

name: Thread the Needle Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross your right ankle over your left knee, creating a figure-4 position.
end_pose_description: Both hands clasp the back of your left thigh, with the left knee drawn towards your chest while maintaining the figure-4 position. Your right arm extends through the opening created by your legs, and the right gluteal muscles and outer hip are visibly stretched.

name: Standing Trunk Rotation
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Cross your arms over your chest with each hand on the opposite shoulder.
end_pose_description: Feet are shoulder-width apart and knees are slightly bent. The torso is maximally rotated to the right, with the head turned to look over the right shoulder. Arms are crossed over the chest with each hand on the opposite shoulder. The right oblique muscles are visibly engaged, and the left oblique muscles are stretched.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
end_pose_description: The body is in a deep squat position, with hips descended until the thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below, and knees deeply bent, tracking over the feet. The chest remains upright with the dumbbell held at chest height, as the glutes and quadriceps are highly engaged, and the calves are stretched.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunges
pose_description: Stand with feet together holding dumbbells at your sides, chest up and core engaged. Maintain an upright posture with weight distributed evenly.
end_pose_description: One leg is fully extended to the side with the foot flat on the ground, while the other leg is bent at the knee, with the thigh parallel to the floor and the knee directly over the ankle. The torso leans slightly forward from the hips, maintaining a proud chest and engaged core, with dumbbells hanging naturally at the sides. The glutes and quadriceps of the bent leg are engaged, and the adductors of the extended leg are visibly stretched.

name: Shoulder Dislocate with Band
pose_description: Stand upright holding a resistance band with hands shoulder-width apart at hip height. Your arms are extended straight with a slight bend in the elbows.
end_pose_description: Stand upright holding a resistance band with hands shoulder-width apart behind your lower back, arms extended straight behind your torso with a slight bend in the elbows. The chest is open and shoulders are externally rotated and pulled back, visibly stretching the pectoral muscles and anterior deltoids.

name: Glute Bridge with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Arms are at your sides.
end_pose_description: The hips are elevated off the floor, aligning the torso and thighs into a straight line from the shoulders to the knees. Knees remain bent over the ankles, actively pressing outward against the resistance band. The gluteal muscles and hamstrings are visibly contracted, with the hip flexors stretched.

name: Banded Shoulder Dislocations
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band with a wide grip in front of your thighs. Keep your arms straight.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the resistance band with a wide grip behind your glutes. Your arms are straight and fully extended, with the shoulders externally rotated. The chest and front of the shoulders are visibly stretched, while the posterior deltoids and rhomboids are engaged to maintain the position.

name: Banded Pallof Press
pose_description: Stand perpendicular to an anchor point with the band looped around a sturdy object at chest height. Hold the band with both hands at your chest with knees slightly bent.
end_pose_description: Maintain the perpendicular stance to the anchor point, keeping knees slightly bent. Both hands are fully extended straight out from the chest, holding the band tautly away from the body. The core, including the obliques and rectus abdominis, is visibly braced to resist rotational force, with the shoulders and triceps also engaged.

name: Banded Woodchop
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band with both hands at your left shoulder height. Your arms are slightly bent.
end_pose_description: Your feet are shoulder-width apart, with your torso and hips rotated to the right. Both hands hold the resistance band down and across your body, positioned outside your right knee, with your arms extended and slightly bent. The right obliques are taut, and the left side of your core and upper back show a controlled stretch.

name: Shoulder Cross Body Stretch
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and bring one arm across your body at shoulder height. Keep your posture upright.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, maintaining an upright posture. The stretching arm extends horizontally across the body at shoulder height. The opposite hand secures the forearm or elbow of the stretching arm, holding it firmly against the chest, with a noticeable elongation of the posterior deltoid and upper back muscles.

name: Sit-to-Stand with Band Assistance
pose_description: Sit upright in a firm chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your hands at chest height. Lean slightly forward with a neutral spine.
end_pose_description: Stand tall and upright with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and a neutral spine. The resistance band is held taut around your hands at chest height, with the quadriceps, glutes, and core muscles visibly contracted.

name: Resistance Band Bicep Curls
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and step on the center of a resistance band. Hold the band ends at your sides with palms facing forward and arms straight.
end_pose_description: Hold the band ends with palms facing forward, and elbows fully flexed. The forearms are elevated, with hands positioned close to the shoulders and the biceps visibly contracted.

name: Resistance Band Chest Press
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and wrap a resistance band around your upper back, holding the ends at chest height with elbows bent. Keep your core engaged and posture upright.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, core engaged, and posture upright. Your arms are fully extended straight forward at shoulder height, holding the resistance band taut in front of your chest. The pectoralis major muscles are visibly contracted, alongside engagement of the anterior deltoids and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Chest Press
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest height with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
end_pose_description: The dumbbells are held directly over the chest, positioned above the shoulders, with arms extended upwards and elbows slightly bent. The pectoralis major and triceps brachii are visibly contracted.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides and palms facing inward. Maintain good posture with a slight bend in your knees.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, maintaining a slight bend in the knees and good posture. Both arms are extended straight out to the sides, forming a T-shape with the body, with the dumbbells held at shoulder height and palms facing the floor. The lateral deltoids and upper trapezius are visibly engaged.

name: Barbell Back Squats
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, barbell resting across your upper back and shoulders. Your chest is upright and core is engaged.
end_pose_description: Your hips are deeply flexed, positioned below your knees, with your thighs parallel to the ground or lower. Your chest remains upright, though your torso is angled forward, and your core is engaged. The glutes and quadriceps are visibly engaged, while the hamstrings are stretched.

name: Weighted Lunges
pose_description: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Your core is braced and shoulders are back.
end_pose_description: One leg is forward with the knee bent at a 90-degree angle, its thigh parallel to the ground, while the other leg is extended back with its knee hovering just above the floor and heel lifted. The torso is upright, core braced, and dumbbells are held at the sides. Both the glutes and quadriceps are visibly contracted, and the hip flexors of the rear leg are stretched.

name: Weighted Step-ups
pose_description: Stand facing a sturdy bench or step holding dumbbells at your sides. Your posture is upright with core engaged.
end_pose_description: You stand fully upright atop the bench, with one foot planted firmly and entirely on its surface, core engaged. The glutes and quadriceps of the lead leg are visibly contracted as the other leg is fully extended and suspended just beneath you, with dumbbells remaining at your sides.

name: Weighted Calf Raises
pose_description: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Your core is engaged and posture is tall.
end_pose_description: The body is balanced on the balls of the feet and toes with heels maximally lifted off the ground. Dumbbells are held at the sides, and the core remains engaged with a tall, straight posture. The calf muscles are visibly contracted and bulging.

name: Walking Lunges with Twist
pose_description: Stand upright holding a weight plate or dumbbell at chest height with both hands. Your feet are hip-width apart and core is braced.
end_pose_description: One leg is forward in a deep lunge position, with the front thigh parallel to the floor and the back knee bent just above the ground. The torso is rotated towards the front leg, as both hands hold the weight plate or dumbbell at chest height. The glutes and quadriceps are engaged, the back hip flexor is stretched, and the obliques are visibly contracting.

name: Banded Squats
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with a resistance band looped under both feet and held at shoulder height. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
end_pose_description: The hips are deeply lowered, with the thighs parallel to the ground or slightly below, and knees sharply bent, tracking over the feet. The chest remains upright and the core is engaged, with the resistance band tautly stretched while still held at shoulder height. The quadriceps and gluteal muscles are visibly contracted, and the hamstrings are under significant stretch.

name: Banded Chest Press
pose_description: Sit upright with the resistance band wrapped around your mid-back, holding both ends at chest level with elbows bent. Keep your shoulders relaxed and back straight.
end_pose_description: Remain seated upright with the resistance band stretched tautly in front of you, arms fully extended straight forward at chest level while holding the band ends. Your shoulders remain relaxed, back straight, and chest muscles are visibly contracted.

name: Banded Rows
pose_description: Sit with legs extended and loop the resistance band around your feet or mid-shin, holding both ends with arms extended. Keep your back straight and shoulders back.
end_pose_description: Maintain the seated position with legs extended, the resistance band still looped around the feet or mid-shin. Your elbows are bent, and hands are held close to the torso, with the back remaining straight and shoulder blades retracted, visibly engaging the latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, and biceps.

name: Banded Bicep Curls
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, standing on the center of the resistance band with both feet. Hold both ends of the band at your sides with palms facing forward.
end_pose_description: The feet remain hip-width apart, standing on the resistance band. Both hands, holding the band ends, are positioned near the shoulders with palms facing forward and elbows fully bent. The biceps and forearms are visibly engaged and contracted.

name: Banded Lateral Raises
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, stepping on the center of the resistance band with both feet. Hold both ends at your sides with arms extended and palms facing inward.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, still stepping on the center of the resistance band with both feet. Both arms are extended laterally to shoulder height, forming a T-shape with the body. The hands grip the band ends with palms facing downward, and the lateral deltoids are visibly engaged.

name: Banded Glute Bridges
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped just above your knees. Place your arms at your sides with palms down.
end_pose_description: The body forms a straight line from the shoulders through the hips to the knees, with hips fully extended and elevated off the floor. Your glutes and hamstrings are visibly contracted, and your hip flexors are stretched. Your upper back and shoulders remain on the floor, with arms at your sides and palms down, while your feet stay flat on the floor, hip-width apart.

name: Banded Standing Kickbacks
pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall or holding onto a stable surface with a resistance band looped around one leg just above the knee. Keep your torso still and core engaged.
end_pose_description: The banded leg is extended directly backward, with the foot elevated slightly off the floor. The standing leg is straight, supporting the still, upright torso and engaged core. The gluteal muscles of the extended leg are contracted, and the hip flexors of the standing leg are stretched.

name: Banded Shoulder External Rotation
pose_description: Sit upright with one elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side, holding one end of a resistance band that is anchored at elbow height. Keep your elbow firmly against your rib cage.
end_pose_description: You remain seated upright with your elbow still bent to 90 degrees and firmly pressed against your rib cage. Your forearm has rotated outward, pulling the resistance band taut, with your hand now positioned further away from your torso. The infraspinatus and teres minor muscles in your shoulder are visibly engaged.

name: Banded Standing Marches
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs above the knees, holding onto a stable surface for balance. Keep your core engaged and posture upright.
end_pose_description: Maintain an upright posture, core engaged, with one foot planted firmly on the ground, supporting the body. The opposite leg is lifted, with the thigh parallel to the floor and the knee bent to a 90-degree angle, foot off the ground. The resistance band is stretched taut above the knees, indicating visible engagement of the hip flexors and quadriceps of the lifted leg, and the gluteus medius of the standing leg for stabilization.

name: Supine Shoulder Rotation
pose_description: Lie on your back with your shoulder abducted 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees, forearm pointing toward the ceiling. Keep your shoulder blade flat against the surface.
end_pose_description: Your shoulder remains abducted 90 degrees and your elbow bent to 90 degrees. The forearm is rotated backward until the back of your hand rests on the surface above your head. The external rotators of the shoulder are engaged, and the internal rotators along the front of the shoulder and chest are stretched.

name: Step-Up with Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand facing a bench or elevated platform holding dumbbells at your sides with your core engaged. Your posture is upright and your feet are hip-width apart.
end_pose_description: You are standing fully upright on the elevated platform with your lead leg extended straight, bearing your full body weight, core engaged, and posture upright. The opposite leg is lifted, with its knee bent and foot hovering above the platform. The glutes, quadriceps, and hamstrings of the extended leg are visibly contracted, and dumbbells remain at your sides.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the ground, holding dumbbells at chest height with elbows at 90 degrees. Your spine is neutral and core is engaged.
end_pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the ground. Dumbbells are held directly above the chest with arms fully extended, perpendicular to the floor. Pectorals and triceps are maximally contracted, while your spine remains neutral, core engaged, and glutes actively contracted to stabilize the hips.

name: Supine Spinal Twist
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with arms extended out to the sides in a T position. Bend your right knee and bring it toward your chest.
end_pose_description: The right knee is extended across the body, now resting on the floor to the left side, with the left leg remaining straight and flat. The torso and lower back are visibly twisted, while the right arm and shoulder stay firmly pressed into the floor. This position shows a deep stretch through the obliques and lower back, with the right glute also engaged.

name: Diaphragmatic Breathing with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band loosely around your torso at chest level with both hands.
end_pose_description: The torso is expanded from a deep, full inhalation, stretching the resistance band tightly around the chest and ribs. The diaphragm and intercostal muscles are engaged, with the lower ribs and abdomen visibly expanded.

name: Shoulder Rolls with Band Resistance
pose_description: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at shoulder height with both hands in front of you. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
end_pose_description: The body maintains a tall stance with feet shoulder-width apart and core engaged. The shoulders are actively pulled back and down, with the shoulder blades squeezed together and depressed. The resistance band is held tautly at shoulder height, pulled horizontally backward. The rhomboids, middle, and lower trapezius are visibly contracted, while the pectoralis muscles are stretched.

name: Standing Torso Rotation with Band
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at chest height with both hands extended in front of you. Engage your core and keep your hips still.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hips still, and your torso rotated fully to one side. Your shoulders are perpendicular to your hips, and both hands remain extended, holding the resistance band at chest height out to your side. Your obliques on the side of rotation are visibly engaged, while the obliques on the opposite side are elongated.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch with Band Assist
pose_description: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge position, holding a resistance band around your back knee. Keep your torso upright.
end_pose_description: The body is in a deep lunge, with the hips positioned fully forward and down, while the torso remains upright and the pelvis posteriorly tilted. The resistance band, held taut around the back knee, assists in maintaining maximal hip extension, visibly stretching the hip flexors of the kneeling leg.

name: Gentle Spinal Twist
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a light resistance band across your chest. Arms are extended out to the sides.
end_pose_description: The individual is on their back with both knees stacked and resting on the floor to one side, feet also stacked. The upper back and shoulders remain flat on the floor, arms extended out to the sides, holding the resistance band taut across the chest. The head faces the direction opposite the knees, and the obliques and outer hip on the side opposite the knees are visibly stretched.

name: Band-Assisted Chest Opening
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat, holding a resistance band behind your back at elbow height with both arms bent. Your chest is slightly rounded forward.
end_pose_description: Your arms are straightened and extended further back, pulling the resistance band taut behind you. Your chest is fully opened and lifted, with the pectoral muscles visibly stretched.

name: Band Pull-Apart for Posture
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended in front of you at shoulder height holding a resistance band with both hands. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended out to your sides at shoulder height, holding the resistance band stretched taut across your chest with a slight bend in your elbows. The shoulder blades are visibly squeezed together, engaging the rhomboids and middle trapezius, while the pectorals are stretched.

name: Quadruped Arm and Leg Lifts
pose_description: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core gently engaged.
end_pose_description: One arm is extended straight forward, palm facing down, with the hand at shoulder height, while the opposite leg is extended straight back, foot flexed, with the heel at hip height. The extended arm and leg are parallel to the floor, maintaining a neutral spine and level hips, with visible engagement of the erector spinae, glutes, hamstrings, and deltoids.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Step
pose_description: Stand upright holding light dumbbells at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
end_pose_description: The body maintains an upright posture, shifted over one leg which is extended laterally with its foot firmly on the ground. The knee of the stepping leg is slightly bent, bearing the majority of the body weight. The other leg is extended straight to the side, with its heel slightly lifted and only the toe lightly touching the ground for balance. Dumbbells are held at the sides. The core is engaged, the gluteus medius and quadriceps of the stepping leg are engaged, and the adductors of the straight leg are visibly stretched.

name: Banded Bicep Curl
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place the resistance band under both feet, holding one end in each hand with arms at your sides. Keep your elbows tucked close to your torso.
