end_pose_description: The torso remains upright with feet hip-width apart, the resistance band still anchored under both feet and held in each hand, while forearms are fully flexed, bringing hands close to the shoulders with palms facing inwards, and elbows tucked close to the torso. The biceps are visibly contracted.

name: Banded Glute Bridge
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Keep your arms at your sides with palms down.
end_pose_description: Your hips are fully raised, aligning your torso and thighs into a straight line from shoulders to knees. Your knees stay bent, pressed outwards against the resistance band just above them, with feet remaining flat on the floor. Your arms are still at your sides with palms down. Your glutes are strongly contracted, hamstrings are engaged, and inner thighs are visibly working.

name: Banded Row
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and loop the resistance band around a stationary object at chest height or hold it in both hands. Extend your arms forward with elbows slightly bent.
end_pose_description: Your hands are positioned back towards your torso, with elbows sharply bent and tucked close to your body. Your shoulder blades are retracted, revealing visible contraction in the back muscles (latissimus dorsi, rhomboids, trapezius) and biceps.

name: Banded Overhead Press
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place the resistance band under both feet. Hold one end in each hand at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the resistance band still under both feet. Both arms are fully extended straight overhead, with hands positioned directly above the shoulders and palms facing forward. The deltoids, triceps, and upper trapezius are visibly engaged, with the latissimus dorsi muscles stretched.

name: Banded Squat
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place the resistance band under both feet, holding one end in each hand at shoulder height. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
end_pose_description: The hips are positioned low, with the thighs parallel to the ground and the knees fully bent, tracking directly over the feet. The chest remains upright, and the core is tightly engaged. The glutes and quadriceps are heavily engaged, and the hamstrings are stretched.

name: Banded Standing Hip Abduction
pose_description: Stand upright with feet together and loop a resistance band around both thighs just above the knees. Place your hands on your hips or hold onto a wall for balance.
end_pose_description: Maintain an upright posture, balancing on one planted leg. The opposite leg is extended straight out to the side, creating maximal tension in the resistance band just above the knees. The gluteus medius and minimus of the extended leg are visibly contracted, and the adductors of the standing leg are stretched. Hands remain on the hips or grasping the wall for stability.

name: Seated Torso Twist
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and cross your arms over your chest. Maintain good posture with your spine neutral.
end_pose_description: Maintain the seated position with feet flat on the floor and arms crossed over the chest. The upper body, including the head and shoulders, is rotated maximally to one side while the hips remain forward, stretching the obliques and back muscles on the opposite side and engaging those on the rotating side.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral.
end_pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, light dumbbells held directly overhead. Your arms are fully extended with straight but not locked elbows, and wrists aligned directly over shoulders. Your core remains engaged and spine neutral, with visible engagement in the deltoids and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls with Breathing
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells in each hand with arms hanging at your sides and palms facing forward. Maintain neutral spine.
end_pose_description: The body is upright with feet hip-width apart and a neutral spine. Dumbbells are near the shoulders, with elbows fully flexed and palms facing upwards. The biceps brachii are visibly contracted and the triceps are stretched.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Rows
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, slightly bend knees, and hinge at hips about 45 degrees. Hold dumbbells with straight arms hanging below shoulders.
end_pose_description: Maintain feet shoulder-width apart, slightly bent knees, and the 45-degree hip hinge. Dumbbells are pulled upwards to the sides of the torso, with elbows bent and pointing towards the ceiling. The upper back and latissimus dorsi muscles are visibly contracted, along with the biceps.

name: Standing Dumbbell Lateral Raises
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells in hands at your sides with palms facing inward. Engage core and maintain neutral spine.
end_pose_description: The body remains upright with feet hip-width apart, core engaged, and spine neutral. The arms are extended laterally, parallel to the floor, with a slight bend at the elbows. Dumbbells are at shoulder height, and palms face the floor, with the deltoid muscles visibly engaged.

name: Banded Quadriceps Sets
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your back supported and a small rolled towel placed under one knee. A resistance band is looped around that thigh for added resistance.
end_pose_description: The upright seated position is maintained with the back supported. The knee on the towel-supported leg is pressed down firmly, causing that heel to lift just above the floor, with the quadriceps visibly flexed and the resistance band taut around the thigh.

name: Banded Standing Hip Extension
pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall or rail with hands lightly resting on it for balance and a resistance band looped around both feet. Keep your standing leg straight and core tight.
end_pose_description: The upright posture is maintained, with the standing leg straight and core tight, and hands lightly resting on the wall or rail for balance. The other leg is extended straight backward, creating peak tension against the resistance band. The gluteal muscles of the extended leg are visibly engaged, while the hip flexors are stretched.

name: Resistance Band Wrist Extension
pose_description: Sit upright with your affected forearm resting on a table, palm facing downward. Hold a looped resistance band around your hand with light to moderate tension.
end_pose_description: Maintain the seated position with the affected forearm resting on the table, palm facing downward. The hand is angled upwards at the wrist, with the back of the hand lifted significantly higher than the forearm, and the wrist extensors on the top of the forearm visibly contracted.

name: Resistance Band Finger Flexion
pose_description: Sit comfortably with your affected hand relaxed in front of you, fingers extended. Loop a resistance band around your fingers with light tension.
end_pose_description: The affected hand remains comfortably in front, with the fingers now fully curled inwards towards the palm. The resistance band is tautly stretched around the flexed fingers, and the flexor muscles along the palm and underside of the forearm are visibly contracted.

name: Resistance Band Shoulder Abduction
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored under your feet. Your affected arm hangs at your side with the band in your hand.
end_pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the stretched resistance band anchored under your feet. The affected arm is positioned straight out to the side, parallel to the floor, with the hand at shoulder height, and the deltoid muscles are engaged.

name: Resistance Band Elbow Flexion
pose_description: Stand upright with your affected arm at your side, holding one end of a resistance band that is anchored under your feet. Your elbow should be slightly bent with palm facing forward.
end_pose_description: Stand upright with your affected arm's forearm fully bent towards your shoulder. Your hand, still holding the resistance band, is near your shoulder, with your palm facing forward. The biceps brachii on the front of your upper arm are maximally contracted, and the triceps on the back are stretched.

name: Shoulder Flexor Stretch with Band
pose_description: Stand upright and hold a resistance band with both hands, arms extended in front of you at shoulder height. Keep your feet shoulder-width apart for stability.
end_pose_description: Stand upright, with your arms fully extended overhead and slightly behind the plane of your body, holding the resistance band taut with both hands. Your feet remain shoulder-width apart for stability. The anterior deltoid and pectoralis major muscles are visibly stretched across the front of the chest and shoulder.

name: Supine Spinal Twist Stretch
pose_description: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms spread out to the sides in a T-position. Your spine should be neutral and relaxed against the floor.
end_pose_description: Both knees are bent, stacked together, and dropped fully to one side of the body, with the outer thigh and hip resting on the floor. The lower back and hips are rotated, while the upper back and shoulders remain flat on the floor, arms still outstretched in a T-position. The obliques, lower back, and outer glutes are visibly stretched in this twisted posture.

name: Standing Lateral Band Walk
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Slightly bend your knees and lean forward with a neutral spine, maintaining tension in the band.
end_pose_description: The lead leg is abducted widely to the side, its knee still slightly bent, while the other leg remains in its initial bent-knee position. The torso maintains its forward lean and neutral spine. The resistance band is fully taut, clearly engaging the gluteus medius and minimus on both hips, with the outer thigh of the lead leg under significant tension.

name: Seated Spinal Rotation with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit upright with good posture and hold a resistance band looped around a fixed point at chest height. Cross your arms over your chest while holding the band with tension.
end_pose_description: The torso is fully rotated to one side, with the chest facing perpendicular to the initial forward-facing position. The seated posture remains upright, and the arms are still crossed over the chest, holding the resistance band tightly taut, with the band now pulling from the side opposite the rotation. The obliques on the rotated side are visibly contracted, while the opposing obliques and the thoracic spine are notably stretched.

name: Prone Y-T-W Raises with Band
pose_description: Lie face down with a resistance band underneath you and both ends held in your hands at shoulder level. Your forehead rests on the floor and core is engaged.
end_pose_description: Your forehead is lifted slightly off the floor, with your gaze directed downward, maintaining a neutral spine. Both arms are fully extended, elevated significantly off the floor, with the resistance band taut and your thumbs pointing towards the ceiling. The muscles of your upper back and shoulders, including the posterior deltoids, rhomboids, and trapezius, are intensely contracted, and your shoulder blades are maximally retracted and depressed.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with a slight bend in your knees. Your shoulders are back and your core is braced.
end_pose_description: Your torso is leaned forward, nearly parallel to the floor, with your back straight and core braced. Your hips are fully hinged backward, and your knees maintain a slight bend, keeping your hamstrings and glutes visibly stretched. The dumbbells hang straight down, positioned around mid-shin level, close to your legs, with your spinal erectors engaged to maintain a flat back.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up with Knee Drive
pose_description: Stand facing a bench or step, holding dumbbells at your sides with your feet hip-width apart. Your posture is upright and you're positioned to step up onto the elevated surface.
end_pose_description: One foot is firmly planted on the elevated surface, with the knee of that leg slightly bent and the glutes and quadriceps visibly engaged. The opposite knee is driven high towards the chest, with the hip flexors visibly contracted, and its foot is elevated off the ground. Your posture remains upright, facing forward, holding the dumbbells at your sides.

name: External Rotation with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit upright with your right elbow bent to 90 degrees against your side and a resistance band around your wrist. Your forearm points forward across your body.
end_pose_description: Sit upright with your right elbow bent to 90 degrees against your side and a stretched resistance band around your wrist. Your forearm points directly forward, away from your body, with the back of your hand facing forward. The infraspinatus and teres minor muscles are visibly contracted.

name: Quadruped Shoulder Rocks
pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
end_pose_description: The hips are positioned back towards the heels, with hands fixed on the floor directly under the original shoulder line. The arms are fully extended, creating a deep stretch through the shoulders and the sides of the torso. The spine is neutral and the core is engaged, with the latissimus dorsi and posterior deltoids visibly stretched.

name: Band-Resisted Shoulder External Rotation
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored at elbow height with your elbow bent at 90 degrees against your side. Your forearm is positioned across your body horizontally.
end_pose_description: The forearm is positioned horizontally, pointing directly away from the body. The elbow remains bent at 90 degrees and pressed against your side. The posterior shoulder muscles, including the infraspinatus and teres minor, are visibly engaged.

name: Glute Bridge with Band Loop
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Your arms are at your sides with palms down for stability.
end_pose_description: Your hips are lifted off the floor, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees. Your glutes and hamstrings are visibly contracted, and the resistance band is taut above your knees, indicating engagement of the hip abductors. Your arms remain at your sides with palms down, and your feet are still flat on the floor, hip-width apart.

name: Calf Stretch with Band Assist
pose_description: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you, placing a resistance band around the ball of one foot while holding the band's ends. Your back is upright and your other leg is relaxed.
end_pose_description: Your hands are pulling the resistance band taut, which brings the ball of your banded foot and toes deeply back towards your shin. Your ankle is in full dorsiflexion, creating a prominent stretch along the posterior lower leg, including the gastrocnemius and soleus muscles. Your back remains upright, and your other leg is relaxed.

name: Quadruped Hip Circles with Band
pose_description: Begin on your hands and knees with a resistance band looped around one knee, positioned on your forearms for added support. Your hips are directly over your knees and your core is braced.
end_pose_description: The working leg's hip is in full extension and abduction, with the bent knee lifted as high as possible towards the ceiling, placing the resistance band under tension. The gluteus maximus and gluteus medius of the working leg are visibly engaged, while the core remains braced to stabilize the torso and pelvis over the supporting leg.

name: Banded Monster Walk
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees, feet shoulder-width apart, and hands behind your head or crossed over your chest. Maintain a quarter-squat position with a slight forward lean.
end_pose_description: The upper body maintains the quarter-squat and slight forward lean, with hands behind your head or crossed over your chest. One foot is positioned laterally, creating a wide stance where the feet are significantly wider than shoulder-width, while the other foot remains grounded. The resistance band is taut and highly stretched between the legs, signaling intense engagement of the gluteus medius and minimus, with the gluteus maximus and quadriceps visibly contracted to maintain the squat.

name: Prone Shoulder Flexion with Band
pose_description: Lie face-down on a table with your arms hanging off the edge, holding a resistance band in both hands with your arms at your sides. Your forehead rests on a small towel and your core is engaged.
end_pose_description: The individual remains face-down on the table, forehead resting on the towel, with the core engaged. Both arms are extended straight forward and upward, reaching parallel to the floor, holding the resistance band taut. The anterior deltoids are visibly contracted, and the shoulder blades are upwardly rotated.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a neutral grip. Keep your chest up, shoulders back, and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Hinge at the hips while keeping your back straight and lowering the dumbbells along your legs until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings. Drive through your heels to return to standing position.

name: Supine Pelvic Floor With Dumbbell Squeeze
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a light dumbbell placed on your lower abdomen. Relax your entire pelvic floor.
end_pose_description: Contract your pelvic floor muscles while gently pressing down on the dumbbell with your lower abdomen for 3-5 seconds. Release and rest before repeating.

name: Resistance Band Glute Activation
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Maintain a slight forward lean from the hips.
end_pose_description: Step one leg out to the side against the band resistance, keeping toes pointing forward and chest upright. Return to center and repeat, feeling the outer glute engage.

name: Deep Core Activation with Band
pose_description: Begin on hands and knees with a resistance band wrapped around your torso at the level of your ribs. Hands are under shoulders and knees under hips.
end_pose_description: Exhale and draw your navel toward your spine, engaging the deep core muscles while maintaining neutral spine. Hold for 5 seconds while gently resisting the band, then release.

name: Resistance Band Clamshells
pose_description: Lie on your side with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Stack your hips and keep your feet together with knees bent at 45 degrees.
end_pose_description: Keeping feet together, open the top knee against the band resistance while maintaining neutral spine alignment. Squeeze the outer glute and hip at the top, then slowly close.

name: Modified Dumbbell Chest Press
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and dumbbells held at chest level with elbows at 90 degrees. Keep your lower back neutral against the mat.
end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells upward and slightly inward until arms are nearly straight, maintaining a slight bend in the elbows. Lower controlled with tension in the chest and core.

name: Glute Squeeze with Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands at chest level. Maintain good posture with shoulders back and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Perform a small squat by bending knees slightly, then powerfully squeeze your glutes as you return to standing, pressing through your heels. Contract your glutes maximally at the top.

name: Quadruped Head Turns
pose_description: Start on hands and knees with shoulders stacked over wrists and hips over knees. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to look over your shoulder toward one hip. Hold briefly before returning to center and repeating on the opposite side.

name: Balance Ball Sitting
pose_description: Sit on a balance/stability ball with feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart. Maintain an upright posture with neutral spine alignment.
end_pose_description: Hold the seated position on the ball while engaging your core to maintain stability. Keep your shoulders relaxed and look straight ahead.

name: Standing Balance with Resistance Band
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Hands can be on hips or extended forward.
end_pose_description: Slightly bend your knees while maintaining tension on the band and shift your weight onto one leg. Hold for 2 seconds, then return to center and repeat on the other side.

name: Neck Flexion and Extension with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around the back of your head and held in both hands at chest level. Keep your shoulders relaxed.
end_pose_description: Gently pull the band forward to flex your neck, bringing your chin toward your chest. Release and return to neutral position, moving slowly and controlled.

name: Seated Shoulder Rolls with Band Resistance
pose_description: Sit upright with a resistance band held taut across your shoulders at mid-chest height, hands gripping the band at shoulder width. Keep your core engaged.
end_pose_description: Roll your shoulders backward against the band resistance while maintaining tension. Complete the circular motion and return to start, focusing on smooth controlled movement.

name: Standing Weight Shifts
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides or lightly touching a counter for light support if needed. Look straight ahead and maintain an upright posture.
end_pose_description: Shift your body weight slowly to one side, feeling the pressure increase through that foot. Return to center and shift to the opposite side in a controlled manner.

name: Scapular Stabilization with Dumbbells
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms extended. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
end_pose_description: Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, squeezing the trapezius muscles, then slowly lower back down. Maintain neutral spine throughout the movement.

name: Upper Back Dumbbell Rows
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides with a neutral grip. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
end_pose_description: Pull the dumbbells up toward your ribcage, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top. Lower with control while maintaining neutral cervical spine.

name: Seated Dumbbell Press
pose_description: Sit upright on a bench with dumbbells held at shoulder height with elbows bent. Maintain neutral spinal alignment and engage your core.
end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled manner without arching your lower back. Lower back to shoulder height with control.

name: Quadruped Rocking - Head Turns
pose_description: Get on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips, maintaining a neutral spine. Look down at the floor between your hands.
end_pose_description: Rock your body backward toward your heels while slowly turning your head to look over your shoulder, then return to center. Alternate head turns with each rocking motion.

name: Diagonal Gaze Shifts
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and your head in neutral position. Focus on a target straight ahead at eye level.
end_pose_description: Shift your gaze diagonally to upper-right, then lower-left in a smooth, controlled manner. Alternate directions and repeat for the prescribed repetitions.

name: Band-Resisted Head Stabilization
pose_description: Sit upright and place a resistance band around your head at forehead level, holding both ends behind your head. Maintain neutral head position with eyes focused forward.
end_pose_description: Apply gentle resistance with your hands while keeping your head perfectly still and your gaze fixed on a target. Hold for 5 seconds then release.

name: Band-Assisted Neck Isometric with Gaze Hold
pose_description: Sit upright and loop a resistance band around your head, anchoring it to your hands positioned at shoulder height. Fix your eyes on a point directly ahead.
end_pose_description: Gently push your head against the band resistance while keeping your gaze perfectly stable on the target. Hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds.

name: Dumbbell Squats with Visual Focus
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Fix your gaze on a stable point ahead at eye level.
end_pose_description: Lower your body by bending at the hips and knees while maintaining your forward gaze and keeping your chest upright. Push through your heels to return to standing position.

name: Dumbbell Farmer's Carry with Head Level
pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a firm grip. Keep your head level and your gaze focused straight ahead.
end_pose_description: Walk forward slowly while maintaining an upright posture and steady gaze. Keep your shoulders level and your core engaged throughout the walk.

name: Standing Dumbbell Rows with Stability
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended down in front of you. Maintain an upright posture with your gaze fixed ahead.
end_pose_description: Pull the dumbbells up toward your chest by driving your elbows back, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your core engaged and your head level throughout the movement.

name: Resisted Jaw Opening with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit upright and loop a light resistance band around your chin. Hold the ends of the band with both hands at chest level with slight tension.
end_pose_description: Gently open your mouth against the band resistance for 2-3 seconds. Return slowly to the starting position without closing your teeth completely.

name: Neck Stretching with Gentle Rotation
pose_description: Sit upright with your shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Keep your jaw relaxed with teeth slightly apart.
end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder, dropping your chin slightly. Hold the gentle stretch for 15-20 seconds and feel the tension in your neck muscles.

name: Neck Isometric with Band Support
pose_description: Sit upright and place a resistance band around the back of your head at ear level. Hold both ends of the band with your hands near your temples.
end_pose_description: Gently press your head forward against the band resistance without moving, maintaining tension for 5-10 seconds while keeping jaw relaxed.

name: Shoulder Shrugs with Band
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band under both feet. Let your arms hang naturally at your sides.
end_pose_description: Lift both shoulders toward your ears against the band resistance, hold briefly, then lower back down with control.

name: Upper Back Extension with Band
pose_description: Sit upright and wrap a resistance band around a fixed point at chest height. Hold both ends with arms extended forward.
end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together, maintaining upright posture and relaxed jaw throughout.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Flyes
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides. Hinge slightly at the hips with a neutral spine.
end_pose_description: Raise both dumbbells out to the sides with a slight bend in your elbows until your arms are parallel to the ground. Squeeze your rear shoulder muscles at the top of the movement.

name: Seated Resistance Band Rows
pose_description: Sit upright with legs extended in front of you and a resistance band looped around both feet. Hold the band ends with both hands at chest level, maintaining good posture with shoulders back.
end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your torso by squeezing your shoulder blades together, keeping elbows close to your body. Hold briefly at the chest, feeling the contraction in your back muscles.

name: Standing Lateral Band Walks
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Keep feet hip-width apart with a slight bend in your knees and hands on your hips.
end_pose_description: Step laterally to one side, maintaining tension on the band and keeping knees slightly bent. Your torso remains upright as you take controlled steps sideways.

name: Supine Glute Bridge with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Arms are at your sides with palms down.
end_pose_description: Push through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders while maintaining band tension. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.

name: Seated Shoulder Press with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band anchored under both feet. Hold the band ends at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees and palms facing forward.
end_pose_description: Press the band upward and slightly forward, extending your arms overhead while maintaining core stability. Lower back to shoulder height in a controlled manner.

name: Seated Upper Back Stretch with Band
pose_description: Sit upright and hold a resistance band at arm's length in front of you with hands shoulder-width apart. Keep your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed.
end_pose_description: Gently pull the band apart while rounding your upper back slightly, feeling a stretch across your shoulders and upper back. Hold this position while maintaining steady breathing.

name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch with Band
pose_description: Stand upright and loop a resistance band around one foot while holding the opposite end. Keep your core engaged and maintain upright posture.
end_pose_description: Gently pull your foot toward your glute using the band, feeling a stretch along the front of your hip and thigh. Keep your knee pointing downward and avoid arching your lower back.

name: Seated Torso Rotation with Band
pose_description: Sit upright with a slight forward lean and hold both ends of a resistance band at chest height. Keep your feet flat on the floor and maintain a neutral spine.
end_pose_description: Rotate your torso to one side, extending the band in front of you while keeping your hips stable. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side for controlled rotational movement.

name: Standing Bicep Curls with Band
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band under both feet. Hold the band ends with palms facing forward and arms extended at your sides.
end_pose_description: Bend your elbows and curl the band upward toward your shoulders, keeping upper arms stationary and maintaining good posture. Lower back to starting position with control.

name: Seated Quadriceps Strengthener with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around one foot. Keep the other foot flat on the floor and maintain upright posture.
end_pose_description: Straighten the leg with the band by extending your knee fully, tightening your quadriceps muscle. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

name: Seated Torso Rotation
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hip-width apart. Cross your arms over your chest with hands touching opposite shoulders.
end_pose_description: Rotate your torso to one side, turning your shoulders and upper back while keeping hips facing forward. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

name: Big Arm Raises with Dumbbells
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent. Maintain upright posture with engaged core.
end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells overhead with a powerful, exaggerated movement, fully extending the arms above the head. Lower with control back to shoulder height.

name: Big Sit-to-Stand with Dumbbells
pose_description: Sit upright on a sturdy chair holding dumbbells at shoulder height, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Lean slightly forward from the hips.
end_pose_description: Stand up with an exaggerated, powerful movement using leg and hip extension, fully extending the knees and hips. Lower back down with control.

name: Big Lateral Reaches with Dumbbells
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side. Keep your torso upright and core engaged throughout.
end_pose_description: Reach the dumbbell laterally and overhead in a large, sweeping arc, fully extending the arm across and upward. Return to starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: Seated Hip Flexor Strengthening with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one foot while holding the other end in both hands.
end_pose_description: Lift the banded leg upward, bringing the knee toward the chest against the band resistance. Hold briefly at the top of the movement with controlled tension.

name: Quadriceps Sets with Band Isometric Hold
pose_description: Lie on your back with a small rolled towel under one knee. Loop a resistance band around the thigh just above the knee for added resistance.
end_pose_description: Tighten the thigh muscle and press the back of the knee into the towel, straightening the leg. Hold the contraction for 5 seconds against the band tension.

name: Seated Hamstring Curl with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one foot and hold the ends in both hands.
end_pose_description: Curl the banded leg backward, bringing the heel toward the glute against the band resistance. Maintain an upright seated position throughout the movement.

name: Seated Shoulder Flexion with Dumbbells
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding a light dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with palms facing forward. Keep your core engaged and back neutral against the chair.
end_pose_description: Slowly raise both dumbbells overhead in a controlled motion, extending your arms fully but without locking your elbows. Hold briefly at the top before returning to shoulder height.

name: Prone Hip Extension with Dumbbell
pose_description: Lie face down on a mat with your forehead resting on your hands for comfort, legs extended straight behind you. Place a light dumbbell in the crook of one knee or hold it against your thigh.
end_pose_description: Lift the leg holding the dumbbell upward, squeezing the glute muscle while keeping the knee slightly bent. Hold at the top for 2 seconds, then lower back down in a controlled manner.

name: Seated Trunk Rotation with Dumbbell
pose_description: Sit upright on a chair or bench with feet flat on the floor, holding one dumbbell at chest height with both hands, elbows bent. Keep your lower body stable and engage your core muscles.
end_pose_description: Slowly rotate your torso to one side, keeping the dumbbell at chest level, then return to center and rotate to the opposite side. Move in a controlled manner, avoiding rapid twisting motions.

name: Standing Balance with Dumbbell Hold
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in one hand at your side with your arm extended. Keep your gaze focused on a fixed point ahead.
end_pose_description: Maintain steady balance while slowly shifting your weight from one foot to the other in a controlled manner. Progress by closing your eyes briefly or standing on one leg if balance allows.

name: Resistance Band Wrist Flexion
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up, holding one end of a resistance band looped under your foot. Your wrist hangs slightly off the edge of the table with the band creating light tension.
end_pose_description: Curl your wrist upward against the band resistance, bringing your palm toward your inner forearm. Hold briefly at the top of the movement before slowly lowering back down.

name: Resistance Band Pronation/Supination
pose_description: Sit upright and hold a resistance band vertically with both hands, one end anchored under your foot. Your elbows stay bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your sides.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearms to turn your palms upward (supination), then rotate back to palms down (pronation), maintaining tension on the band throughout the movement.

name: Resistance Band Bicep Curl
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, standing on a resistance band with both feet. Hold the other end of the band in each hand with arms extended downward and palms facing forward.
end_pose_description: Curl your hands upward toward your shoulders against the band resistance, keeping your elbows stationary. Squeeze briefly at the top before lowering back to the starting position.

name: Forearm Flexor Stretch with Band
pose_description: Stand with your right arm extended in front of you at shoulder height with your palm facing down. Loop a resistance band around your fingers and hold the other end in your left hand.
end_pose_description: Use the band to gently pull your fingers back toward your wrist, extending the forearm flexor muscles. Feel a comfortable stretch along the underside of your forearm and hold for 20-30 seconds.

name: Forearm Extensor Stretch with Band
pose_description: Stand with your right arm extended in front of you at shoulder height with your palm facing up. Loop a resistance band around your fingers and hold the other end in your left hand.
end_pose_description: Use the band to gently pull your fingers down toward your wrist, stretching the forearm extensor muscles. Feel a comfortable stretch along the top of your forearm and hold for 20-30 seconds.

name: Shoulder Mobility Band Pull-Apart
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band with both hands at chest height about shoulder-width apart. Your arms are slightly bent and the band has light tension.
end_pose_description: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward and slightly backward, opening your chest while keeping your arms at chest level. Slowly return the band to the starting position with control.

name: Lying IT Band Stretch
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your head neutral and arms at your sides.
end_pose_description: Pull your right knee across your body toward your left shoulder using your hands, keeping your shoulders flat on the floor. Hold this position while feeling the stretch along the outer hip.

name: Prone Shoulder External Rotation
pose_description: Lie face down on a bench with your right arm hanging off the side, elbow bent at 90 degrees. Keep your shoulder abducted at 90 degrees with your forearm pointing downward.
end_pose_description: Rotate your shoulder externally, raising your forearm upward toward the ceiling while keeping your elbow fixed at 90 degrees. Slowly lower back down with control and repeat for repetitions.

name: Resistance Band Radial Deviation
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table in neutral position, holding one end of a resistance band anchored under your opposite foot. Your thumb side faces upward.
end_pose_description: Your wrist deviates toward the thumb side against the band resistance. The movement is small and controlled.

name: Resistance Band Ulnar Deviation
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table in neutral position, holding one end of a resistance band anchored under your opposite foot. Your pinky side faces upward.
end_pose_description: Your wrist deviates toward the pinky side against the band resistance. The movement is small and controlled.

name: Resistance Band Pronation
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your body, palm facing upward. Hold a resistance band with both hands at the ends.
end_pose_description: Your forearm rotates so your palm faces downward against the band resistance. The upper arm remains stationary against your body.

name: Resistance Band Supination
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your body, palm facing downward. Hold a resistance band with both hands at the ends.
end_pose_description: Your forearm rotates so your palm faces upward against the band resistance. The upper arm remains stationary against your body.

name: Hip Internal Rotation with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a resistance band around both feet just above the arches.
end_pose_description: Keeping your right foot planted, rotate your left knee inward toward the midline of your body against the band resistance. Return to center and repeat before switching sides.

name: Monster Walks with Band
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Maintain a slight forward lean with knees bent in a quarter-squat position.
end_pose_description: Take a step forward and slightly outward with one leg, keeping tension on the band and maintaining hip stability. Alternate legs in a controlled stepping pattern while keeping your torso upright.

name: Prone I-Y-T Raises with Band
pose_description: Lie face-down on a bench or table with your chest supported and feet on the ground, holding a resistance band in both hands with arms hanging down. Your forehead is neutral looking toward the floor.
end_pose_description: Raise your arms in three positions: I (straight overhead), Y (45-degree angle), and T (90-degree angle), squeezing your rear shoulder muscles at the peak of each movement.

name: Band-Resisted Shoulder Internal Rotation
pose_description: Stand with right side toward a fixed point where the band is anchored at elbow height. Bend your right elbow 90 degrees with upper arm against your ribs, forearm pointing outward, holding the band.
end_pose_description: Pull the band across your body using internal rotation, bringing your forearm toward your midline while keeping your elbow stationary. Control the return to start position.

name: Quadruped Shoulder Stabilization
pose_description: Start on hands and knees with hands shoulder-width apart and knees hip-width apart, maintaining a neutral spine. Shoulders are packed down with scapulae stable.
end_pose_description: Slowly lift one arm forward to shoulder height while maintaining stability through the opposite shoulder and core. Return and alternate sides with controlled movements.

name: Band Rows - High to Low
pose_description: Stand facing a fixed anchor point with the band attached at high level, feet hip-width apart. Hold the band with both hands at shoulder height with arms extended.
end_pose_description: Pull the band down and toward your body by retracting your shoulder blades, bringing your hands to your ribcage level. Squeeze your back muscles and control the return.

name: Dumbbell Deadlifts
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms straight. Your chest is upright and core is engaged.
end_pose_description: Hinge at the hips and slightly bend your knees while lowering the dumbbells toward the ground, keeping your back straight and chest forward. Return to standing by driving through your heels.

name: Band-Assisted Shoulder External Rotation
pose_description: Sit upright with a resistance band looped around both hands, elbows bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your ribs. Your forearms point forward at the starting position.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearms outward against the band resistance, opening your chest and engaging your rotator cuff. Your elbows remain stationary against your ribs throughout the movement.

name: Band-Resisted Neck Flexion
pose_description: Sit upright and place a resistance band around the back of your head, holding both ends of the band in your hands at chest level. Your head is in a neutral position.
end_pose_description: Gently flex your neck forward against the band resistance, bringing your chin toward your chest in a controlled manner. Maintain steady resistance throughout the movement without jerking.

name: Lying Spinal Twist
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms extended out to the sides in a T position. Keep your shoulders relaxed and pressed into the floor.
end_pose_description: Lower both knees to one side, rotating your spine and pelvis while keeping your shoulders on the floor. Feel a gentle stretch through your back and hold, then repeat on the opposite side.

name: Reverse Fly with Dumbbells
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides, palms facing inward. Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the ground with a neutral spine.
end_pose_description: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc, keeping a slight bend in your elbows. Lift until your arms are parallel to the ground, squeezing your rear shoulder muscles and upper back at the peak of the movement.

name: Resistance Band Forearm Pronation
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, held close to your side with your palm facing up. Loop the resistance band around your hand and hold the other end under your foot.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm so your palm faces downward against the band resistance. Control the movement and return slowly to the palm-up starting position.

name: Resistance Band Forearm Supination
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, held close to your side with your palm facing down. Loop the resistance band around your hand and hold the other end under your foot.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm so your palm faces upward against the band resistance. Control the movement and return slowly to the palm-down starting position.

name: Grip Strengthening with Band
pose_description: Sit upright with your arm resting in your lap, holding a resistance band looped in your hand. Your fingers are relaxed and extended slightly.
end_pose_description: Squeeze the band firmly with all your fingers, creating a tight grip. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds, then slowly release to the starting position.

name: Shoulder Shrugs with Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms extended. Maintain neutral spine and relaxed neck position.
end_pose_description: Elevate both shoulders toward your ears in a shrugging motion, hold briefly at the top, then lower back down in a controlled manner. This strengthens the upper trapezius and stabilizer muscles.

name: Neck Rotation - Active Range of Motion
pose_description: Sit upright with good posture, shoulders relaxed, and eyes looking straight ahead. Keep your head level and neutral.
end_pose_description: Slowly rotate your head to look over one shoulder, moving through your full comfortable range of motion without forcing. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side. Perform controlled, gentle rotations.

name: Dumbbell Rows - Bilateral
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, slight bend in knees, and a dumbbell in each hand hanging at your sides with palms facing inward. Maintain neutral spine with shoulders back and down.
end_pose_description: Pull both dumbbells up toward your chest by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your neck neutral and shoulders engaged. Lower dumbbells back down in a controlled manner.

name: Hamstring Curls with Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell between your feet at ankle height. Engage your core and keep your torso stable.
end_pose_description: Bend the knee and curl the dumbbell up toward your glute, keeping the thigh stationary. Return to starting position with control.

name: Step-Ups with Dumbbell
pose_description: Stand facing a low step or platform, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Step up onto the platform with one leg, driving through your heel and standing fully upright at the top. Step back down with control.

name: Scapular Stabilization with Band
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and hold a resistance band at chest height with both hands, arms extended straight ahead. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed away from ears.
end_pose_description: Slowly pull the band toward your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together, keeping elbows slightly bent. Hold the peak contraction briefly while maintaining neutral spine.

name: Glute Bridge with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Arms rest at your sides with palms down.
end_pose_description: Drive through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling while pressing gently outward against the band. Squeeze your glutes at the top while maintaining a neutral spine and controlled breathing.

name: Kneeling Core Stability with Band
pose_description: Kneel upright with hips over knees, holding a resistance band anchored at chest height with both hands in front of your chest. Maintain neutral spine and engaged abdominals.
end_pose_description: Rotate your torso to one side, extending the band diagonally across your body while keeping your hips stationary. Return to center with control and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Hamstring Curl with Band
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped around one foot and holding the other end in both hands for tension. Maintain neutral posture with slight knee bend.
end_pose_description: Curl your foot toward your buttocks against the band resistance while keeping your hip stable and thigh vertical. Lower with control to the starting position.

name: Standing Spinal Rotation
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hands crossed over chest or behind head. Keep your hips still and facing forward.
end_pose_description: Rotate your torso to one side, holding the rotation for a moment to feel the stretch in your mid-back and obliques. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

name: Seated Shoulder Press with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, knees at 90 degrees. Hold the resistance band anchored under your feet with handles at shoulder height, elbows bent at 90 degrees.
end_pose_description: Press the band handles overhead until arms are nearly fully extended, maintaining an upright posture. Lower back to shoulder height in a controlled manner.

name: Lying Hamstring Curl with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Loop the resistance band around one foot and hold the ends in both hands for stability.
end_pose_description: Curl the banded foot toward your glutes by bending the knee, maintaining tension on the band. Straighten the leg with control back to the starting position.

name: Seated Chest Press with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with the resistance band wrapped around your mid-back and thorax. Hold the band ends at chest level with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
end_pose_description: Press the band forward until arms are nearly fully extended at chest height. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

name: Standing Lateral Leg Raise with Band
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Hands can rest on your hips or a chair for balance.
end_pose_description: Lift one leg out to the side against the band resistance, keeping toes forward and torso upright. Lower the leg back to center with control.

name: Seated Row with Band
pose_description: Sit upright with legs extended or slightly bent, with the resistance band looped around both feet. Hold the band ends with arms extended forward at chest height.
end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your body by bending your elbows, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.

name: Seated Bicep Curl with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, with the resistance band anchored under your feet. Hold the band handles with arms extended down at your sides, palms facing forward.
end_pose_description: Curl the band handles up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows while keeping upper arms stationary. Lower back down with control to the starting position.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Your core is engaged and your back maintains a neutral position against the chair.
end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled manner until your arms are nearly fully extended. Your shoulders remain stable and engaged throughout the movement.

name: Seated Dumbbell Bicep Curl
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat, arms hanging at your sides holding dumbbells with palms facing forward. Your elbows stay close to your torso throughout the movement.
end_pose_description: Curl the dumbbells upward by bending your elbows, bringing the weights toward your shoulders in a controlled manner. Your upper arms remain stationary while only your forearms move.

name: Prone Dumbbell Rows
pose_description: Lie face down on a bench or sturdy surface with dumbbells on the ground beneath your shoulders, arms extended. Your core is engaged and your neck remains neutral, looking slightly downward.
end_pose_description: Pull the dumbbells upward toward your ribcage, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your back muscles are fully engaged at the top of the movement.

name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at your sides with arms extended and palms facing inward. Your core is engaged and your posture is upright.
end_pose_description: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a controlled motion until your arms are approximately parallel to the ground at shoulder height. Your elbows maintain a slight bend throughout the movement.

name: Seated Torso Rotation Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hands crossed over your chest. Your spine is tall and your shoulders are relaxed.
end_pose_description: Gently rotate your torso to one side, allowing your shoulders to follow the movement while keeping your hips facing forward. Hold the stretch feeling the muscles along your back and torso lengthen.

name: Standing Dumbbell Goblet Squats
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands cupping the top end. Your chest is up, core engaged, and weight distributed evenly across your feet.
end_pose_description: Lower your body by bending your knees and hips as if sitting into a chair, keeping the dumbbell at chest height. Your knees track over your toes and your chest remains upright throughout the movement.

name: Seated Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and good posture. Bring your affected arm across your body at shoulder height.
end_pose_description: Use your opposite hand to gently pull your affected arm closer to your chest, feeling a stretch across the back of the shoulder. Hold the stretch position steady and breathe deeply.

name: Seated Shoulder External Rotation with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with back supported and feet flat. Hold a resistance band with elbows bent 90 degrees at your sides and palms facing inward.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearms outward against band resistance, keeping elbows stationary at your sides. Return slowly to starting position and repeat with controlled movement.

name: Kneeling Quadruped Shoulder Reaches
pose_description: Start in a quadruped position on hands and knees with shoulders directly over wrists and hips over knees. Maintain a neutral spine throughout.
end_pose_description: Slowly reach your affected arm forward and slightly across your body, extending through the shoulder while keeping your torso stable. Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Shoulder Flexion with Resistance Band
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band under both feet with handles in each hand at your sides. Keep your arms relaxed at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
end_pose_description: Slowly raise both arms forward and upward to shoulder height, keeping the band taut and resisting its tension. Lower arms back to the starting position with controlled movement.

name: Shoulder Abduction with Resistance Band
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, standing on a resistance band with both feet while holding the handles at your sides. Keep your arms relaxed and your core engaged.
end_pose_description: Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height, maintaining tension in the band throughout the movement. Slowly lower your arms back down in a controlled manner.

name: Elbow Flexion Curls with Resistance Band
pose_description: Stand on a resistance band with both feet, holding one handle in each hand with arms extended straight down at your sides. Keep your elbows close to your body and maintain an upright posture.
end_pose_description: Bend your elbows and curl both hands up toward your shoulders, keeping the band tension consistent and elbows stationary. Slowly lower your arms back to full extension.

name: Finger Flexion and Extension with Band
pose_description: Sit comfortably and place a resistance band looped around all four fingers of one hand with the band anchored under your foot or held in the opposite hand. Your fingers should be in a relaxed, extended position.
end_pose_description: Curl your fingers inward, flexing against the band resistance while keeping your palm flat. Slowly extend your fingers back to the starting position.

name: Horizontal Adduction with Resistance Band
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart while holding a resistance band anchored at shoulder height in front of you. Extend both arms out to the sides at shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbows.
end_pose_description: Pull both arms together in front of your chest, squeezing your chest muscles against the band tension. Slowly return to the starting position with arms extended out to the sides.

name: Supine Shoulder Internal Rotation
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Position the affected shoulder at 90 degrees with elbow bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing upward.
end_pose_description: Gently lower the forearm across your body toward the floor, feeling a stretch across the front and back of the shoulder. Hold gently without forcing the movement.

name: Seated Neck Rotation
pose_description: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Keep your eyes looking straight ahead.
end_pose_description: Slowly turn your head to the right, trying to bring your chin toward your shoulder while maintaining an upright posture. Hold briefly and return to center, then repeat on the left.

name: Walking Lunges with Dumbbells
pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with feet together. Take a controlled step forward with your right leg.
end_pose_description: Lower your body by bending both knees until your back knee nearly touches the ground and your front thigh is parallel to the floor. Push off your front foot to step forward with your opposite leg.

name: Quadruped Bird Dogs
pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core gently engaged.
end_pose_description: Simultaneously extend your right arm forward and left leg backward, creating a straight line from fingertips to heel. Return to starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Seated Upper Body Band Pull-Apart
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band at chest height with both hands, arms extended straight out in front of you.
end_pose_description: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward in an arc, bringing the band to chest level with elbows slightly bent. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end position.

name: Seated Shoulder Flexion with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Stand on a resistance band with both feet and hold the ends in each hand at your sides.
end_pose_description: Raise both arms forward and upward to shoulder height, keeping elbows slightly bent. Return to starting position with controlled movement.

name: Supine Chest Stretch with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back on a mat with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band across your chest with both hands.
end_pose_description: Gently press the band outward and across your body, allowing your chest to open and stretch. Hold this position, feeling a gentle stretch across the front of your chest.

name: Seated Shoulder Internal Rotation with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band with elbows bent at 90 degrees, upper arms at your sides.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearms inward toward your body against the band resistance. Return to the starting position with control.

name: Seated Hip Flexion with Band
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one foot and hold the other end with your hands.
end_pose_description: Lift the banded leg by raising the knee up toward your chest against the band resistance. Lower back down with control and repeat on both sides.

name: Supine Lower Back Stretch with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one knee.
end_pose_description: Gently pull the banded knee toward your chest and across your body, creating a stretch through your lower back and hip. Hold the stretch position, breathing deeply.

name: Dumbbell Chest Press - Seated
pose_description: Sit upright on a sturdy chair with back support, holding a light dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Feet are flat on the floor with knees at 90 degrees.
end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells forward and slightly upward until arms are nearly extended without locking the elbows. Return to start position in a controlled manner.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls - Standing
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides holding light dumbbells with palms facing forward. Maintain an upright posture with core engaged and knees slightly bent.
end_pose_description: Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders by bending the elbows while keeping upper arms stationary. Lower back to starting position with control.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises - Seated
pose_description: Sit upright on a chair with back support, holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms extended and palms facing inward. Feet are flat on the floor.
end_pose_description: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until they reach shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbows. Slowly lower them back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Rows - Seated
pose_description: Sit upright on a chair with back support, holding a light dumbbell in one hand with arm extended downward. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
end_pose_description: Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip by bending the elbow and squeezing the back muscle. Return to starting position with control and repeat on both sides.

name: Resistance Band Shoulder Press
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Loop the resistance band under your feet and hold the ends at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
end_pose_description: Press the band upward and outward, extending your arms overhead while maintaining control. Return to the starting position with a slow, controlled movement.

name: Standing Quad Sets with Band
pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall or sturdy support with one hand lightly resting on it for balance. Loop the resistance band around your thigh just above the knee.
end_pose_description: Tighten your quadriceps muscle and straighten your leg by tightening the thigh muscles against the band resistance. Hold the contraction briefly, then relax while keeping your leg straight.

name: Seated Spinal Twist Stretch
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and your back against the chair. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your core gently engaged.
end_pose_description: Gently twist your torso to one side, placing your right hand on your left knee while your left hand rests behind you. Hold the stretch gently, then return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Pronation and Supination Rotation
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and forearm supported on a table, starting with your palm facing down. Keep your elbow stationary against the table throughout the movement.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm upward (supination), then reverse to palm down (pronation). Move through the full range of motion slowly and controlled.

name: Grip Strengthening with Band Squeeze
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on your lap, holding a resistance band in your hand with all fingers and thumb relaxed around it. Your elbow is bent at 90 degrees.
end_pose_description: Squeeze the band firmly with your entire hand, including your thumb, for a maximum contraction. Hold the squeeze while maintaining thumb stability without allowing it to bend excessively.

name: Gentle Wrist Flexion Stretch with Band Assist
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing up, using a resistance band looped around your hand for gentle assistance. Your wrist is in a neutral position.
end_pose_description: Gently pull your hand toward your forearm using the band, creating a stretch along the back of your wrist and forearm. Hold this comfortable stretch position, ensuring your thumb remains relaxed.

name: Finger Extension with Resistance Band Alternative (Towel Roll)
pose_description: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down. Place a small towel roll under your fingers just below the knuckles.
end_pose_description: Slowly straighten your fingers by lifting them upward against the resistance of the towel. Hold briefly at full extension without locking your joints.

name: Forearm Pronation and Supination
pose_description: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your side, forearm at neutral with palm facing downward. Keep your upper arm stationary throughout.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm upward (supination), then rotate back and turn palm downward (pronation). Move slowly through the full available range.

name: Thumb Opposition with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand in neutral position with fingers extended. Loop a resistance band around your thumb and index finger.
end_pose_description: Bring your thumb across your palm to touch the base of your little finger against light band resistance. Return slowly to the starting position.

name: Wrist Flexion with Light Weight
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand extended beyond the edge with palm facing up. Hold a 1-2 pound weight in your hand.
end_pose_description: Slowly curl your wrist upward, bringing your palm toward your forearm. Lower the weight back down with control.

name: Wrist Extension with Light Weight
pose_description: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand extended beyond the edge with palm facing down. Hold a 1-2 pound weight in your hand.
end_pose_description: Slowly lift your hand upward by extending your wrist. Lower the weight back down with control.

name: Resistance Band Toe Flexion
pose_description: Sit upright and loop a resistance band around the forefoot just behind the metatarsal heads. Keep your heel on the floor and foot relaxed.
end_pose_description: Press your great toe downward against the band resistance, flexing the hallux joint while keeping your heel planted. Hold briefly and return to start.

name: Resistance Band Toe Extension
pose_description: Sit with your leg extended and loop a resistance band around your great toe, holding the band ends in your hands. Keep tension on the band with your foot in a neutral position.
end_pose_description: Pull your great toe upward toward your shin against the band resistance, extending the hallux joint maximally. Maintain control and return slowly to neutral.

name: Resistance Band Adduction with Great Toe
pose_description: Sit upright and loop a resistance band around both great toes, holding the band ends in your hands with slight tension. Keep your feet relaxed with adequate space between them.
end_pose_description: Pull your great toes together against the band resistance, moving them toward midline adduction. Return slowly and repeat for controlled strengthening of the foot intrinsics.

name: Hamstring Stretch with Band
pose_description: Lie on your back with one leg bent and foot flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around the foot of the extended leg.
end_pose_description: Use the band to gently pull the extended leg toward your chest, keeping your knee relatively straight. Feel a stretch along the back of the thigh and hold for 30 seconds.

name: Hallux Flexion with Band Resistance
pose_description: Sit with your leg extended in front of you on a chair or bench. Place a resistance band around the ball of your foot just below the toes.
end_pose_description: Curl your toes downward against the band resistance, creating tension in the sole of the foot. Hold for 2 seconds at maximum contraction.

name: Hallux Extension with Band
pose_description: Sit with your leg extended and a resistance band looped around your toes. Keep your foot relaxed in plantarflexion.
end_pose_description: Pull your toes upward against the band resistance, extending the great toe toward your shin. Maintain tension for 2 seconds.

name: Seated Great Toe Abduction with Band
pose_description: Sit with your leg extended and loop a resistance band around both great toes. Start with toes together.
end_pose_description: Separate your great toes against the band resistance, creating an abduction movement. Hold the separation for 2 seconds.

name: Band-Resisted Hip Abduction Standing
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Hands on hips or lightly touching support.
end_pose_description: Step one leg out to the side against the band resistance, keeping your torso upright. Return to start and alternate sides.

name: Supine Glute Bridge with Dumbbell
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a dumbbell across your hips, holding it with both hands for stability.
end_pose_description: Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top while maintaining stable foot positioning.

name: Prone Dorsiflexion Hold with Dumbbell Resistance
pose_description: Lie face-down on a bench with your feet hanging off the edge. Place a dumbbell on top of your feet near the toes, holding it in place.
end_pose_description: Pull your toes toward your shins, lifting the dumbbell through the dorsiflexion movement. Maintain the upward position briefly before slowly lowering back to the starting position.

name: Seated Calf Raises with Dumbbell
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Place a dumbbell on top of each thigh near the knees, holding them in place with your hands.
end_pose_description: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground against the dumbbell resistance. Hold briefly at the top before lowering your heels back down.

name: Quadruped Foot Stability Taps
pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise.
end_pose_description: Lightly tap one foot to the side while maintaining stability through your supporting leg and upper body. Return and alternate sides with controlled, precise movements.

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch with Band
pose_description: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one foot while keeping the other leg straight on the ground.
end_pose_description: Pull the band to gently draw the banded leg toward your chest, creating a stretch along the back of the thigh. Keep your head and lower back relaxed against the floor.

name: Standing Hamstring Curl with Band
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band looped around both feet. Hold the band ends for stability or place hands on a wall for balance.
end_pose_description: Bend one knee and curl your heel up toward your glutes while maintaining an upright posture. Return to starting position and repeat before switching legs.

name: Standing Quad Set with Band Assist
pose_description: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your thigh just above the knee. Keep your standing leg straight and engaged with slight knee bend.
end_pose_description: Tighten your quadriceps to straighten the knee fully while pulling upward slightly with the band. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds while maintaining balance.

name: Seated Hip Internal Rotation with Band
pose_description: Sit upright on the floor with one leg extended and the other knee bent, foot flat. Loop a resistance band around the bent leg's foot or lower shin.
end_pose_description: Gently rotate the bent leg inward across your body using the band for light assistance. Stop at a comfortable stretch in the outer hip and hold briefly before returning.

name: Reverse Lunge with Rotation
pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell at chest height with both hands, feet shoulder-width apart. Core is engaged with neutral spine.
end_pose_description: Step backward with the affected leg into a lunge position while rotating the torso toward the front leg. The back knee lowers toward the ground with weight distributed through the front ankle.

name: Dumbbell Step-Ups with Deceleration
pose_description: Stand facing a step or bench holding dumbbells at your sides, feet together. The affected leg is positioned to step up first onto the elevated surface.
end_pose_description: Step up with the affected leg, driving through the ankle and pushing to stand fully on the step. Slowly lower back down with controlled deceleration through the ankle.

name: Rotation Stretches
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, arms spread out at shoulder height. Keep your shoulders flat against the floor.
end_pose_description: Gently drop both knees to one side in a controlled manner, allowing your spine to rotate while maintaining contact with the floor. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Band External Rotation at 90/90
pose_description: Stand with your shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees, holding a resistance band anchored at shoulder height. Your upper arm is parallel to the floor with the band creating slight tension.
end_pose_description: Externally rotate your shoulder to bring your forearm up toward the ceiling while keeping your elbow in place. The motion is controlled and purposeful, with maximum external rotation at the end position.

name: Band Internal Rotation at 0 Degrees
pose_description: Stand with your arm at your side and elbow bent to 90 degrees, holding a resistance band anchored at waist height. Your forearm starts pointing away from your body with slight band tension.
end_pose_description: Internally rotate your shoulder to bring your forearm across your body toward your midline. The movement is slow and controlled, finishing with a brief pause at the end of the range.

name: Band Shoulder Abduction
pose_description: Stand with arms at your sides holding a resistance band anchored under your feet. The band has slight tension with your arms in a neutral position.
end_pose_description: Abduct your shoulders by raising your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height. The movement is controlled with the band providing resistance throughout the motion.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit upright with your legs extended in front of you. Place a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding the ends in your hands.
end_pose_description: Pull your toes toward your shin against the band resistance, creating tension in the front of your ankle. Hold briefly at the top of the movement.

name: Lateral Ankle Stability with Dumbbell Reach
pose_description: Stand on one leg holding a light dumbbell at your side, keeping your core engaged and standing leg stable. Focus on the ankle of your support leg.
end_pose_description: Reach the dumbbell across your body and toward the ground in a controlled manner, challenging your ankle stabilizers. Return to standing position.

name: Plantarflexion with Dumbbell Weight
pose_description: Sit upright with one leg extended and place a light dumbbell on top of your forefoot. Keep your leg relaxed on the chair.
end_pose_description: Point your toes downward against the dumbbell weight, engaging your calf muscles. Hold the end position briefly before returning to start.
