name: Standing Band Ankle Inversion with Stability
pose_description: Stand upright holding onto a stable surface with one leg slightly lifted and a resistance band looped around the forefoot. Your stance leg is engaged with a slight knee bend.
end_pose_description: Turn your foot inward against band resistance while maintaining balance and control. Your ankle movement is deliberate and stabilized by engagement of the surrounding muscles.

name: Seated Tricep Extension with Band
pose_description: Sit upright and hold one end of a resistance band overhead with one arm bent at the elbow. Secure the other end under your seated position.
end_pose_description: Straighten the overhead arm by extending the elbow upward against the band resistance. Lower slowly with control and repeat on both sides.

name: Banded Good Morning
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and loop a resistance band around your neck and hold the ends. Keep your knees slightly bent and your spine neutral.
end_pose_description: Hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso while maintaining a straight back and neutral spine. Return to standing by driving through your heels and engaging your posterior chain.

name: Banded Quadruped Reach
pose_description: Start on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around both feet. Keep your core tight and back flat.
end_pose_description: Reach one arm forward while simultaneously sliding the opposite knee out to the side against the band. Return to center and alternate sides smoothly.

name: Banded Superman
pose_description: Lie face down with a resistance band held in both hands extended above your head. Keep your legs straight and forehead neutral on the floor.
end_pose_description: Pull the band down toward your sides while lifting your chest and legs off the ground. Squeeze your back muscles and hold briefly at the top.

name: Prone Thoracic Rotation with Band
pose_description: Lie face down with a resistance band held in both hands extended above your head on the ground. Keep your legs straight and core engaged.
end_pose_description: Rotate your torso to one side, bringing the band toward the floor beside you, rotating through your mid-back. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

name: Resistance Band Reverse Pec Flyes
pose_description: Sit upright with feet flat on the floor and a resistance band anchored at chest height in front of you, holding both ends with arms extended forward. Your shoulders should be relaxed and spine neutral.
end_pose_description: Pull the band outward and backward, squeezing your shoulder blades together as your arms move to your sides. Your chest opens and upper back engages fully.

name: Standing Torso Twist
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place your hands behind your head with elbows out to the sides. Keep your hips still and facing forward.
end_pose_description: Rotate your upper body to one side, moving only from the waist and rib cage. Return to center and twist to the opposite side in a controlled manner.

name: Anti-Rotation Press with Rotation
pose_description: Stand perpendicular to a cable machine with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the handle at chest level with both hands. Engage your core and keep your shoulders level.
end_pose_description: Press the cable away from your body while simultaneously rotating your torso toward the cable. Hold at full extension, then return to start with control.

name: Quadruped Breathing with Arm Lifts
pose_description: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Your spine is neutral and core is engaged.
end_pose_description: Inhale and extend your right arm forward to shoulder height while maintaining spinal stability. Exhale as you return to start, then repeat on the left side.

name: Quadruped with Band-Assisted Balance
pose_description: Begin on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around your waist, anchored to a stable object at chest height for light support. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral.
end_pose_description: Extend one leg straight back and the opposite arm straight forward, creating a diagonal line through your body. Hold briefly while maintaining balance with minimal band support, then return to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Farmer's Walk
pose_description: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms extended. Keep your shoulders relaxed and spine neutral.
end_pose_description: Walk forward slowly while maintaining an upright posture and keeping dumbbells at arm's length. Engage your core and keep your gaze forward.

name: Elbow Extension with Resistance Band
pose_description: Sit upright with your affected arm bent at the elbow, keeping the upper arm stationary against your side. Loop a resistance band around your forearm and hold the other end with your opposite hand for resistance.
end_pose_description: Slowly straighten your affected arm by extending the elbow against the band resistance. Hold the fully extended position for 1-2 seconds before returning to the start position.

name: Seated Elbow Flexion with Band
pose_description: Sit upright with feet flat on the floor, with the resistance band secured under your foot. Hold the band's handle in your affected hand with your arm extended downward.
end_pose_description: Bend your elbow to bring your hand up toward your shoulder against the band's resistance. Lower your arm slowly to full extension with control.

name: Tricep Extension with Band
pose_description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band overhead with both hands, elbows bent at 90 degrees behind your head. Keep your core engaged and upper arms pointing upward.
end_pose_description: Extend your elbows upward to straighten your arms while holding the band overhead. Maintain control and return to the bent position without letting your elbows flare out to the sides.

name: Seated Toe and Heel Taps with Band Loop
pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, with a light resistance band looped around the front of both feet. Keep your hands on your thighs for stability.
end_pose_description: Tap your toes upward against the band's resistance, lifting the balls of your feet while heels remain grounded. Then reverse the motion, pressing your toes down and lifting your heels to work the opposing muscles.

name: Plantar Fascia Release with Ball
pose_description: Sit in a chair with your foot flat on the ground or elevated slightly. Have a foam roller or massage ball ready.
end_pose_description: Roll the ball along the arch of your foot from heel to toe, applying moderate pressure. Spend extra time on tender spots to release tension in the plantar fascia.

name: Seated Plantar Fascia Stretch with Band
pose_description: Sit upright with one leg crossed over the opposite knee so the sole of your foot faces you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of the foot.
end_pose_description: Gently pull the band toward your shin to dorsiflex the foot, creating a stretch along the bottom of the foot and arch. Hold the stretch for 30 seconds.

name: Grip Strength with Ball
pose_description: Sit upright holding a soft therapy ball or stress ball in your palm with fingers relaxed around it. The splinted finger is protected and rests on top of the ball.
end_pose_description: Gently squeeze the ball using your unaffected fingers and palm, keeping the splinted finger relaxed on top without flexing at the tip joint. Release and repeat for gentle grip training.

name: Banded Crab Walk
pose_description: Loop a resistance band around your thighs just above the knees and stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Bend your knees slightly and hinge slightly forward at the hips.
end_pose_description: Step backward at a diagonal angle while maintaining tension on the band and keeping your chest up. Continue stepping in reverse, maintaining band tension throughout.

name: Clams with Resistance Band
pose_description: Lie on your side with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees, hips and knees bent at 45 degrees, and feet together. Keep your core engaged and head supported on your lower arm.
end_pose_description: Rotate your top knee upward against the band resistance while keeping your feet together and lower body stable. Pause at the top before slowly lowering back to the starting position.

name: Side-Lying Leg Lifts
pose_description: Lie on your side with your bottom arm extended and head resting on it, legs stacked together. Engage your core and keep your torso stable.
end_pose_description: Lift your top leg to hip height while maintaining a slight forward angle of the leg, then lower it back down without touching your bottom leg. Keep your upper body still throughout.

name: Knee Flexion with Resistance Band
pose_description: Stand upright facing a wall with a resistance band looped around the foot of one leg and held in your hand. Keep your standing leg slightly bent for stability.
end_pose_description: Bend the knee, pulling your heel toward your buttocks against the band resistance while keeping your thigh stationary. Slowly return to the starting position.

name: Seated Standing March with Resistance Band
pose_description: Stand upright facing a sturdy chair with a resistance band around your thighs just above the knees. Maintain good posture with hands on the chair for light support.
end_pose_description: March in place by lifting one knee up against the band resistance while maintaining balance. Alternate legs in a controlled, steady rhythm.

name: Cervical Rotation with Band Support
pose_description: Sit upright with a resistance band looped around your head, with the band positioned at your temples. Hold the band taut with both hands at chest level.
end_pose_description: Slowly rotate your head to look over one shoulder while the band provides gentle resistance. Maintain the rotation for 2 seconds before returning to center.

name: Neck Rotation Stretch - Supine
pose_description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Keep your head in neutral position resting on a low pillow or towel roll.
end_pose_description: Gently rotate your head toward the unaffected side, allowing gravity to assist in the stretch. Hold this position to release tension in the affected sternocleidomastoid muscle.

name: Quadruped Pelvic Floor Hold
pose_description: Position yourself on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Maintain a neutral spine with core gently engaged.
end_pose_description: Contract the pelvic floor muscles strongly while maintaining stable quadruped position for 5 seconds. Keep breathing steady and avoid holding your breath.

name: Side-Lying Ribcage Expansion
pose_description: Lie on your left side with your left arm extended on the ground and right arm resting on your torso. Your hips and shoulders are stacked.
end_pose_description: Inhale deeply while opening your right arm up and back, rotating your ribcage and thorax toward the ceiling. Exhale as you return your arm to your torso.

name: Banded Shoulder Stabilization
pose_description: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and a resistance band looped around both wrists at chest height. Your arms are extended forward with a slight bend in the elbows, maintaining neutral posture.
end_pose_description: Pull the band apart by moving your arms outward in a controlled motion, engaging your shoulder stabilizers. Your arms remain at chest height with elbows slightly bent as you create tension in the band.

name: Banded Triceps Extension
pose_description: Stand on one end of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the other end at shoulder height with your elbow bent. Keep your elbow close to your torso and upper arm stationary.
end_pose_description: Extend your arm upward and slightly forward, straightening the elbow against the band resistance until your arm is nearly fully extended. Lower back to the starting position with controlled tension throughout.

name: Crossbody Shoulder Stretch
pose_description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and shoulders relaxed, with your affected arm hanging naturally at your side. Maintain an upright posture with your core engaged and gaze forward.
end_pose_description: Use your opposite hand to gently grasp the elbow or upper arm of the affected side and pull it across your body toward your chest. Hold this position while maintaining an upright posture, feeling the stretch across the back of the shoulder and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Farmer's Carries
pose_description: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with neutral wrist and shoulder position. Engage your core and maintain tall posture.
end_pose_description: Walk forward maintaining upright posture, shoulders level, and neutral neck alignment. Focus on keeping both shoulders balanced and avoiding lateral neck flexion throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Presses
pose_description: Sit upright with your back against a bench or chair, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with elbows bent. Your core is engaged and your feet are flat on the floor.
end_pose_description: Press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled motion until your arms are nearly fully extended. Lower them back to shoulder height with control.

name: Prone Scapular Y-Raises with Band
pose_description: Lie face down on a comfortable surface with arms at your sides holding a light resistance band. Keep your forehead on a small pillow to maintain neutral cervical spine.
end_pose_description: Raise both arms overhead in a Y-position while engaging your lower trapezius. Hold briefly at the top before lowering, avoiding excessive shoulder strain.

name: Resistance Band Face Pulls
pose_description: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored at eye level with both hands, arms extended forward. The band should be taut with slight tension.
end_pose_description: Pull the band toward your face, separating your hands as they approach, with elbows high and wide. Your shoulder blades squeeze together as the band reaches near your temples.

name: Sidelying External Rotation with Band
pose_description: Lie on your left side with your right shoulder flexed to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees. Hold a resistance band with your right hand at chest level.
end_pose_description: Externally rotate your shoulder by rotating your forearm upward against the band resistance. Keep your elbow fixed at your ribs and control the return to starting position.

name: Standing Cable External Rotation with Arm at 90 Degrees
pose_description: Stand sideways to a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart, elbow bent at 90 degrees and arm raised to shoulder height. Hold the cable handle with a neutral grip.
end_pose_description: Rotate your forearm backward in an external rotation movement, creating resistance against the cable while maintaining your elbow position.
